ཿ tsūgre04༅/sdu (sdomel9 84rten ge chi dri spro nga da la ( 9 r+sha za dz+ra467) rdzo 4 74༄67 ༄75 7༅09 sdudzo ru tswa she| (4 ( nga 5te de dharma ji nge rteng —— ci/dzo (4 nen me kā r+sha 75446049pa'i las༅ sna na ni chodamo1—rdzo
ga //rig snang 'tshad44ston nu'i byan la //dan pa ce' klong tsā ba pa'i stobs grol//su'i rtag r+sha mdzod rgya za'i mas bad mtho/mi 4'a ma dbya snam ma ga ba 'deb /

gsal bshad/༄༄/ /(nges shes sgron me rtsa 'grel〉zhes pa'i pod 'di ni/nged dpe skrun khang gis par du skrun pa'i 'ju mi pham gyi gsung rtsom gces btus nang gi pod gcig yin/ pod 'di'i nang gi rtsa ba (nges shes rin po che'i sgron me〉 'di mkhas pa'i yang rtser son zhing grags pa'i snyan pas phyogs kun khyab pa'i mkhas mchog dam pa 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho gang nyid sku na shin tu gzhon pa'i dus shig na gsungs par mdzad ces 'grel pa'i sbyar byang na gsal bar 'khod do/ /de'i 'grel pa nges shes rin po che'i sgron me'i tshig gi don gsal ba'i 'grel chung blo gros snang ba'i sgo 'byed〉 ces pa 'di ni gang gi thugs kyi sras mchog kun bzang dpal ldan zhes bya ba mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan yongs su grags pa gang des brtsams gnang mdzad pa zhig yin/1
nga bis ba

dkar chaganges shes rin po che'i sgron me/ (1)nges shes rin po che'i sgron me'i tshig gi don gsal ba'i 'grel chung blo gros snang ba'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ (57)mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/ (59)thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/ (61)ma rnga rtsan bstan pa/ (61)mchod par brjod pa/ (62)bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ (63)sa bcad dang po/ gleng gzhi'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ (63)gcig tshad ma gnyis dang bral ba'i skyon/ (64)gnyis / lam yang dag dang de'i gzugs brnyan gyi khyad par/ (64)gsum / lam yang dag dang der zhugs pa la bsngags pa/ (65)bzhi / dri lan tshul gyis ji ltar bstan tshul bshad pa/ (67)1

sa bcad gnyis pa/ so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa/ (72)dri lan dang po/ lta ba mthar thug med dgag dang ma yin dgag tu 'dod pa gang 'thad bstan pa/ (72)gcig gzhan lugs brjod cing rang lugs bzhag pa mdor bstan pa/ (73)gnyis / rgyas par bshad pa/ (77)11 mi 'thad pa gzhan lugs dgag pa/ (77)kha1 gzhan gyi med dgag kyang ma yin dgag tu 'gyur zhing tshig dang don gyi gzhan stong la zung 'jug mi rung bar mdor bstan pa/ (78)kha2 gzhan gyi med dgag kyang ma yin dgag tu 'gyur zhing tshig dang don gyi gzhan stong la zung 'jug mi rung bar rgyas par bshad pa/ (81)ga1 lung rigs khas blang dang 'gal ba/ (81)kha2 zung 'jug sogs mi rung bar bstan pa/ (85)yin 'thad ldan rang lugs bzhag pa/ (87)dri lan gnyis pa/ nyan rang dgra bcom pas chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'am ma rtogs pa gang 'thad bstan pa/ (95)2

gcig mi 'thad pa dgag pa/ (95)gnyis / 'thad ldan rang lugs bzhag pa/ (100)11 dpal ldan zla bas ji ltar bstan tshul/ (100)kun rang lugs klong chen zhabs kyis de ltar bzhed tshul/ (102)13 de la dogs pa bsal te mthar thug chos kyi bdag med nges par rtogs dgos tshul/ (104)kha1 spyir bstan pa/ (104)kha2 bye brag lung don legs par bkral te 'khrul ba bsal ba (109)kha3 de kho na nyid mthong bas theg gcig 'grub tshul gsungs pa gzhan la mi 'thad cing rang la 'thad tshul bstan pa/ (112)gsum / des na byams klu dgongs pa gcig tu bstan pa/ (114)dri lan gsum pa/ mnyam bzhag 'dzin stangs yod med gang 'thad la gnyis ku'ang legs par phye ste brten pa/ (115)gcig cir yang mi 'dzin pa/ (116)11 legs par rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa gnyis yod pa mdor bstan pa/ (116)12 rgyas par bshad pa/ (118)gnyis / bdag med du 'dzin pa/ (125)3

11 dang po'i las can rim gyis pa'i bsgom tshul spyir bstan pa/(125)kha1 bdag med gnyis yang dag par shes pa'i 'dzin stangs dgos tshul/ (125)kha2 med 'dzin de yang phyi nas spang dgos tshul/ (128)kha3 dngos gzhi 'dzin stangs kun bral du bstan pa/ (129)12 thos bsam lta ba'i lugs kyi bsgom tshul bye brag tu bstan pa/ (130)gsum / log rtog blun sgom dang yang dag pa'i sgom gyi khyad par/ (133)bzhi rka/ bsgom pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin stangs kun gzhig dgos tshul/ (135)dri lan bzhi pa/ bsgom pa dpyad 'jog gang 'thad bstan pa/ (136)gcig gzhan lugs brjod pa/ (136)gnyis / rang lugs so sor phye ste bstan pa/ (137)11 spyir bstan pa/ (137)12 rim pas bye brag tu bstan pa/ (143)13 de la log rtog bsal te lam mchog tu bsgrub pa/ (146)kha1 log rtog bsal te dpyod shes kyi 'dzin stangs kun dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag ye shes nyid theg chen lam gyi dngos gzhi 4

theg pa dang chen po'ang yin par bstan pa/ (147)kha2 tshul des a ti yo ga rgyud kyi mthar thug dang theg pa'i rtse mor bstan pa/ (151)kha3 de nyid gtan la 'beb par byed pa gang zhig gzhan las mchog tu bstan pa/ (153)kha' mdo rgyud man ngag gi bstan don mthar thug thams cad 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen por dbye ba med cing de nyid kun gyi 'byung gnas su bstan pa/ (155)kha5 ye shes de nyid so so'i skye bos rjes mthun pa bsgom du yod tshul bstan pa/ (157)gsum / don bsdu ba/ (159)dri lan lnga pa/ bden pa gnyis las gang gtso/ (160)gcig gzhan lugs dgag pa/ (160)gnyis / rang lugs bzhag pa/ (164)ku1 bden gnyis zung 'jug rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba mdo rgyud man ngag zab mo'i lam kun gyi dgongs pa 'khrul med yin par bstan pa/ (165)12 tshul de nyid rtogs pa'i gnad las rgyud sde'i dbye ba 5

bstan pa/ (171)13 de la log rtog bsal ba (175)kha1 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ma dag par 'dod pa'i log rtog bas 9 5 ba (175)kha2 rgyud sde la lta ba'i mtho dman med par 'dod pa'i log rtog bsal ba (178)kha3 lta ba'i dbang gis theg dgur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/ (179)1 4 ༄ don bsdu ba/ (180)dri lan drug pa/ snang ba gcig nyid mi gcig par mthong ba'i thun mong gi blta bya gang 'thad/ (182)gcig mi 'thad pa gzhan lugs so sor dgag pa/ (182)gnyis / 'thad ldan rang lugs bzhag pa/ (187)11 thun mong du spyir bstan pa/ (187)kha1 snang stong zung 'jug mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa/ (188)kha2 de la tshad ma dang tshad min mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba/ (189)gnya rang lugs la mngon rjes kyi tshad ma grub cing don med ma yin par bstan pa/ (189)6

ga2 gzhan la tshad ma'i rnam bzhag mi 'thad par bstan pa/ (191)ga3 de phyir tshad mar bsgrub pa/ (192)nga1 gnas skabs gnyis su bzhag pa/ (193)ca1 ma dag tshur rol mthong ba'i tha snyad tshad ma/ (193)can dag pa'i gzigs pa la brten pa'i tha snyad tshad ma/ (194)nga2 mthar thug gcig tu bsgrub pa/ (195)nga3 de phyir dag pa chen por bsgrub pa thun mong min pa/ (196)12 dag mnyam dbyer med chen por bye brag tu bstan pa/ (197)kha1 thun mong gi blta bya snang stong re res mi rung bar bstan pa/ (198)kha2 zung 'jug dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med du bstan pa/ (202)ga1 gzhi gnas tshul snang stong zung 'jug rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba mthar thug pa gnas snang rnam kun mthun pa'i dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med du bstan pa/ (202)nga1 don dam du mnyam pa chen por bstan pa/ (203)nga2 kun rdzob tu dag pa chen por bsgrub pa/ (204)nga3 mthar thug dbyings ye bden pa dbyer med zung 'jug tu bstan pa/ (207)gan sa lam snang tshul dag dang ma dag par gnas snang mi mthun 7

par sna tshogs su snang tshul/ (208)ga3 de ltar rtogs pa dang rtogs pa'i skyon yon 'bras bu bstan pa/ (210)kha3 dag mnyam chen por grub pa'i tshul dang nges pa'i yon tan/(211)13 bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba/ (213)dri lan bdun pa/ spros bral dbu ma chen po la khas len yod med/ (215)gcig khas len med pa'i lugs dgag pa/ (215)gnyis / khas len yod med so sor phye ba'i klong chen zhabs kyis bzhed pa 'god pa/ (217)gsum / der brten khas len yod pa'i phyogs ches cher bsgrub pa'i gzhan lugs dgag pa/ (219)bzhi / klong chen zhabs kyi rjes su 'brangs te rang lugs rgyas par bstan pa/ (223)yi1 rang lugs la so sor phye ste bzhag pa/ (223)kha1 mnyam rjes sam rgyu 'bras kyi dbu ma gnyis su bstan pa/ (224)kha2 des na gnas lugs dbu ma chen po'i ngor khas len med par bstan pa/ (226)8

kha3 snang tshul la tha snyad bden gnyis so sor khas len yod par bstan pa/ (227)kun de la rtsod pa spang ba/ (229)kha1 rang la mtshungs pa'i rtsod spang / (229)ga1 rtsod pa dgod pa/ (229)gan rtsod pa de spang ba/ (230)nga1 rnam shes dang ye shes sam mnyam rjes sam gnas snang gi skabs kyi khyad par phyes te bstan pas gshis la khas len med pa'i phyir na snang tshul la yod med kyi khas len gnyis yod kyang dpyad bzod la sogs pa'i skyon rang la med par bstan pa/ (230)nga2 tshul des log rtog gzhan yang khegs par bstan pa/ (235)nga3 rang la bden gnyis khas len nang 'gal gyi skyon med par bstan pa/ (237)ga3 lung nas dgag sgrub ji snyed pa bstan tshul gyi sgo nas mi 'gal bar don bsdu ba/ (239)kha2 gnyis ka stobs mtshungs bden pa'i rtsod spang / (241)ga3 bden pa gnyis su phye ste khas len dang bcas pa bstan pa'i dgos 'bras bstan pa/ (245)9

kha4 rgyu'am lam gyi dbu ma'i khas len de yang don dam rang lugs su byas nas kun rdzob gzhan ngor skyel nas lung rigs kyis gnod tshul bstan pa/ (248)13 tshul des mdo sngags kyi lam gnad bstan pa/ (251)kha 1 mdo sngags kyi lam gnad thun mong du spyir bstan pa/ (251)gnya mdor bstan pa/ (251)ga2 rgyas par bshad pa/ (253)ga3 don bsdu ba/ (258)kha2 mdo sngags kyi lam gnad dang lta ba'i khyad par bye brag tu bstan pa/ (259)kha3 tshul des gzhan yang mtshon tshul bstan pa/ (261)sa bcad gsum pa/ yi rangs kyis bsngags par brjod cing don bsdus te gdams pa/ (263)gcig yi rangs shing gus pas bstod cing ngo mtshar chos kyi sgron me gzhan la gsal bar mdzad par bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ (264)gnyis / chos mchog 'dzin cing shong ba'i snod bstan pa/ (270)gsum / bsdus te snying po'i gdams pa dngos/ (271)10

sa bcad bzhi pa/ ji ltar bstan pa'i don bsdu ba/ (277)tha mar dge ba mjug gi don/ (278)gcig lhag bsam shes rab kyis go phyes pa/ (278)gnyis / gzhan phan snying rjes ji ltar brtsam pa'i mdzad byang / (279)gsum / tshul 'dir brten na theg pa mchog gi lam bzang rnyed pas brten par gdams pa/ (280)
sa rin po che'i spro'aju mi pham gyis ma

༄7/ /gang yid the tshom dra ba'i sbubs 'thums pa/ /'byed byed 'jam dpal rdo rje'i mar me ni/ /snying la nges shes zab mo'i tshul 'jug pa/ /lam bzang mthong ba'i mig der bdag kyang dad/ /kye ma zab mo'i gnas lugs la/ /sbyor byed nges shes rin po che/ /khyod med pas na srid pa 'di/ /sgyu ma'i rgyar ni 'thums shing rmongs/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos rnams la/ /nges pas yid ches 'drong ba dang la/ /thos pas dad par byed pa gnyis/ /lam dang de yi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rmad byung chos kyi zla ba'i grags pa ni/ /legs bshad gsung gi 'od dang chabs cig par/ /thub bstan lha lam yangs por shar ba yis/ /the tshom mun pa thib po rnam par 'joms tha snyad dpyod pa'i tshad ma yis/ /blang dor 'jug ldog mi nor zhing / /khyad par bstan dang ston pa la/ /yid ches rnyed pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /tshad ma'i gzhung dang gnas lugs don/ /gtan 'bebs don dam rig shes kyi/ /tshad ma dri med gsal byed pa/ /theg mchog dbu ma rnam pa gnyis/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i blo mig zung / /bgrad de ston pas bstan pa'i lam/ /der ni gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /yang dag zhugs pa de la bsngags/ /de ltar sems pa'i drang srong la/ /thol byung sdom bu pa zhig gis/ /rtog ge'i brgal brtag bya ba'i phyir/ /3

dri ba bdun po 'di ltar dris/ /gzhan gyi rjes su zlos la mkhas pas ci / /rang gi rnam par dpyod pa bag phob la/ /dris pa'i lan 'di nye bar ldon mdzod dang / /nang gi rnam dpyod mthong ba bzhin du gsal / /mang thos sna zhags ring du brkyangs na yang / /khron pa'i chu ltar zab pa'i chos kyi chu/ /ma myong da rung mkhas pa'i grags pa la/ /re ba rigs ngan btsun mor chags dang 'dra/ /lta ba dgag gnyis gang ltar smra/ /nyan rang bdag med gnyis rtogs sam/ /mnyam bzhag 'dzin stangs yod dam med/ /dpyad nas bsgom mam bzhag nas bsgom / /bden pa gnyis las gang zhig gtso/ /mi gcig mthun snang blta bya gang / /dbu mar khas len yod dam med/ /de skad stong nyid las brtsams pa'i/ /zab mo'i dri ba bdun po 'dir/ /lung dang 'gal ba med bzhin du/ /rigs pas grub pa'i lan thongs shig /rtog ge'i tshig phreng tsher ma'i mdung / /'bum gyis bsnun kyang mi phig pa / /che rnams rmongs pa'i dka' gnad la/ /smra ba'i ljags ring glog bzhin rkyongs/ /de ltar blo gros kyis bskul ngag gi rlung / /chung ngur g.yos pa des kyang drang srong snying / /dus mtha'i rlung gis ri bzhin bsgul gyur nas/ /mi smra'i brtul zhugs dar gcig bzung ba'i mthar / /kye ma brgya phrag dka' ba'i khur brten cing / /yang dang yang 4

dpyad blo gros rnon po'i me/ /brgyud mar ches cher sbar ba de/ kyang 'di / /skyon bral khams su bsgrub par mi nus na/ /lhan skyes spobs pa'i blo nus zhan gyur cing / /yun ring sbyangs pa'i khur kyang ma bzung ba / /dman pa bdag gis smra ba ga la zhes/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la gdung ba'i shugs kyis bos/ /de tshe de yi mthu las yin snyam pa'i/ /yid la tho rangs dus kyi snang ba ltar/ /spobs pa'i go skabs cung zad thob pa'i mod/ /legs gsungs don bzhin rigs pas dpyad de smras / /dge ldan lta ba med dgag zer/ /gzhan rnams ma yin dgag tu smra/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs gang zhe na/ /zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i ngor/ /med ces dgag bya bkag shul gyi/ /med rkyang dang ni ma yin zhes/ /bkag shul chos gzhan ci zhig 'phen/ /de gnyis blo yis brtag pa tsam/ /don la gnyis kur khas mi len/ /dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /blo 'das gdod ma'i chos nyid yin/ /stong tshul kho nar bsams nas ni/ /dri na med dgag nyid yin te/ /'phags yul dpal ldan zla ba dang / /bod na rong zom chos bzang gnyis / /dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis/ /ka dag stong pa chen po bsgrubs/ /chos 'di ka nas dag pa'am/ /gdod nas rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /bden pa gnyis char ma skyes pas/ /5

med ces brjod la ci zhig tshom/ /ka ba ka nas dag pa yi/ /shul na mi stong cung zad med/ /ka ba med ces ma bkag na/ /ka ba min zhes ci zhig yin/ /ka ba kheg pa'i stong pa dang / /shul na lus pa'i snang ba gnyis/ /stong dang mi stong zung 'jug tu/ /mi rung srad bu sgrim pa bzhin/ /ka ba ka bas mi stong dang / /chos nyid ka bas stong ngo zhes te/ /stong gzhi bzhag nas gzhan stong pa/ /tshig dang don gyi gzhan stong gnyis/ /e ma des de ma stong na/ /stong gzhi mi stong lhag mar lus / /gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo zhes/ /lung don rigs par bcas las 'gal/ /ka ba ka ba'i bden grub gnyis/ /gcig na gcig kheg gcig kyang kheg /gzhan na ka ba ma yin pa'i/ /bden grub kheg kyang ka ba ni/ /gang gis mi stong dpyad bzod 'gyur/ /bden grub yod ma myong ba'i phyir/ /gcig dang tha dad mi dgos na/ /bden grub med kyang so skye'i ngor/ /bum pa bden par 'dzin pa'i phyir / /mi stong bum pa'i pha rol na/ /bden par grub rgyu su zhig yin / /dgag bya'i snang tshul nges so lo/ /bden grub sogs kyi khyad par gang / /dgag byar sbyar nas ston pa ni/ /rang rgyud gzhung la grags mod kyang / /don dam dpyod pa'i dbang du na/ /de sbyar ba la dgos pa ci/ /stong na kun rdzob tsam du yang / /ka ba med pa ltar 6

sems nas/ /tshig 'khri'i dogs pas 'di byas kyang / /tshig 'khri'i 'gal ba 'di la che/ /kun rdzob tsam du ka ba ni/ /yod ces byas pas mi chog par/ /des de mi stong ci la zer/ /de gnyis don gcig yin zer na/ /ma yin ka ba yod ces dang / /ka bar ka ba yod ces pa / /mi mtshungs phyi ma rten brten par/ /don gyi khas blangs song ba bzhin / /don dam ka ba mi dmigs na/ /ka ba ka bas mi stong ci/ /kun rdzob ka ba ka bas zhes/ /lan gnyis brjod pa brda la rmongs/ /rang ni rang gis mi stong na/ /rang yod bzhin du gzhan gyis stong / /dgag bya gzhan du med gyur na/ /rang gis mi stong khas len 'gal/ /spyir na gzhan gyis stong pa des/ /stong go nges par mi chod de/ /rta la ba lang ma grub kyang / /rta de stong par ga la nges/ /rta mthong de yis ba lang la/ /ci zhig phan te ci zhig gnod/ /de phyir mi stong myang 'das dang / /'khor ba'ang chos dang chos nyid du/ /mi rung snang stong zung 'jug dang / /srid zhi mnyam nyid 'di la med/ /chu zla zla ba min no zhes/ /gnam zlas stong dang chu zla rang / /snang de zung 'jug yin na ko /zung 'jug rtogs pa sus kyang sla/ /ba lang rta min kun gyis shes/ /ba lang snang bar mngon sum mthong de rtogs ngo mtshar che'o zhes/ /bdag nyid chen po ji ste gsungs/ /des 7

na rang gi lugs la ni/ /chu zla brtags na chu zla nyid/ /cung zad mi rnyed med bzhin du/ /chu zla snang bar mngon sum tshe/ /med dgag yin kyang snang rung ba/ /stong dang yod pa so skye'i blor/ /'gal yang 'dir ni mngon sum du/ /zung 'jug 'di la rmad byung zhes/ /ngo mtshar tshig gis mkhas rnams bsngags/ /stong pa'i ngos nas gzhal ba na/ /mi stong cung zad yod min phyir/ /med ces mtha' gcig smrar gtub kyang / /med de'i med tshugs ma shor bzhin/ /snang ba 'gog med nyid du shar/ /snang de'i snang tshugs ma shor bzhin/ /gzhi med stong pa chen por gnas/ /de la 'di stong 'dis stong dang / /'di snang 'di stong dbye ba zhig /nam yang rnyed pa med pa la/ /kho thag nang nas chod pa'i tshe/ /don tshol mkhan po don med pas/ /yid chad skye ba med kyi steng / /yid bde thob pa ngo mtshar che/ /'ga' zhig nyan rang dgra bcom pas/ /chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs zer/ /phung por nga tsam 'dzin pa'i bdag /ma kheg de srid de'i nus pas/ /nyon mongs spong ba med pa dang / /bdag de'ang phung po la brten nas/ /btags tsam ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi/ /yul yin de dang bum sogs la/ /stong gzhi'i dbye ba ma gtogs pa/ /stong tshul khyad par 'ga' med de/ /chos dang gang zag so sor yang / /rang 8

bzhin grub pas stong phyir ro/ /de ltar lung dang rigs pas kyang / /mngon sum grub las brgal nas su/ /nyan rang chos bdag ma rtogs zhes / /smra ba dam bca' tsam du zad/ /de la kha cig thal ches nas/ /theg gsum mthong lam gcig pa dang / /rtogs pa mtho dman med par 'dod/ /sher phyin sngags sogs mdo rgyud gzhung / /kun kyang drang ba'i don du 'grel/ /de la dman lam sngon song ba'i theg chen mthong lam thob sogs tshe/ /spang bya cung zad med sogs skyon/ /rigs pas gnod pa zlog med 'bab/ /gzhan yang rtogs bya rtogs gyur kyang / /spang bya spong bar grogs dgos zer/ /ma rtogs rtogs par khas blang 'gal/ /rtogs na spang bya mi spong 'gal/ /nyi ma shar yang mun pa'i dpung / /'joms pa gzhan la ltos pa mtshar /kha cig nyan rang rang rgyud kyi/ /phung po lnga po stong rtogs kyang / /chos gzhan bdag med mi rtogs zer/ /phung po lnga po stong rtogs na/ /'dus ma byas tsam ma gtogs pa'i/ /ma rtogs dngos gzhan ci zhig yod / /des na rang lugs gang yin na/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i rang 'grel las/ /nyon mongs spang phyir nyan rang la/ /rgyal bas gang zag bdag med dang / /shes sgrib spangs phyir rgyal sras la/ /chos bdag med pa rdzogs par bstan/ /'o na nyan rang gnyis po la/ /stong nyid 9

rtogs pa yod do zhes/ /smras pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ /nyan rang de dag kun nyon tsam/ /spangs phyir gang zag med sgom gyi/ /chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par ni/ /sgom pa med ces gsungs pa bzhin/ /klong chen rab 'byams zhal snga nas/ /sngon gyi slob dpon thams cad ni / /yod dang med ces rtsod na yang / /rang bzhed sngon gyi nyan rang la/ /ci rigs snang yang dgra bcom pa/ /'thob la phung por 'dzin pa'i bdag /stong par ma rtogs thar min pas/ /de tsam rtogs pa yod na yang / /bdag med rdzogs par rtogs pa med/ /yungs 'bru srin gyis zos pa yi/ /nang gi mkha' bzhin nyan rang gi /bdag med chung ngu gsungs pa ste/ /de phyir dman la dgag pa'i sgras / /chos bdag ma rtogs zhes bzhed gsungs/ /'di ni phul byung legs bshad de/ /'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan ma mchis/ /dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i chu/ /hub gang btung yang rgya mtsho ni/ /ma btung zhes su mi rung ltar/ /chos kyi bye brag nga tsam po/ /bdag med mthong phyir stong mthong 'dod/ /hub gcig 'thung bas rgya mtsho'i chu/ /rdzogs par khong du ma song ltar/ /mtha' dag shes bya'i rang bzhin kun / /stong par rtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /bdag med rdzogs par ma mthong 'dod/ /gal te chos gcig stong mthong na/ /thams cad mi 10

mthong ci zhe na/ /de gas lung rigs man ngag gis/ /brtags na de ltar mthong mod kyi/ /re zhig nyan thos rigs can rnams/ /gang zag med tsam kho na la/ /zhen pas mtha' gzhan rtogs dka' ste/ /bum pa btags par 'dod rnams kyang / /rdul phran rdzas su 'dod pa bzhin / /gal te bum pa btags pa ni/ /rtogs pa'i blo des rdul la yang / /dpyad na rtogs par rigs mod kyi/ /re zhig ma rtogs de bzhin no/ /rags pa'i gzhi dang cha med rdul/ /'gal bar snang yang de dag la/ /re zhig lung dang man ngag gis/ /dben phyir mi 'gal grub mtha' sgrub/ /de bzhin sems tsam dag gis kyang / /gzung ba med na 'dzin pa yang / /ci phyir mi rtogs rang rgyud pas/ /don dam bden med rigs pa des/ /tha snyad du yang rang mtshan gyis/ /grub pa med par cis mi rtogs/ /des na thams cad thal 'gyur ba/ /'ba' zhig nyid du khyod la thal/ /nyan rang theg pa chen po la/ /skur zhing smod pa'ang ga la srid/ /des na gcig gi rang bzhin nyid/ /kun la mnyam nyid yin na yang / /phyi dang nang gi rkyen gyi tshogs/ /ma tshang de srid rtogs pa bul/ /spyir na dbang rnon rang stobs kyis/ /rtogs pa yod kyi rtul po yis/ /rang gi de ma thag tu yang / /nges par rtogs pa'i khyab pa med/ /nam zhig cis kyang rtogs nges te/ /11

bskal pa stong phrag bcu yi mthar/ /'gog pa'i dbyings las dgra bcom pa/ /ldang ste theg chen 'jug par gsungs/ /tshul bzhin theg chen zhugs pas kyang / /grangs med bskal par goms dgos na/ /nyan thos zhi bde don gnyer bas/ /bskal pa stong phrag de tsam la/ /bdag med mtha' dag ma rtogs pa'i/ /gnas skabs mi srid ci la 'gyur / /sa thob rnams la'ang chos kyi dbyings/ /je bas je gsal rdzogs min nam/ /tshogs bsags grogs dang rig pa'i sgo/ mtha' yas tshul dang byang sems kyi/ /spyod pa yongs bsngo'i rkyen tshang na/ /nges par rdzogs par rtogs 'gyur te/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rkyen tshang bas/ /sngags kyi myur du rtogs pa bzhin/ /rtag bdag spangs kyang lhan skyes kyi/ /ngar 'dzin phung por brten nas 'jug /de phyir phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid ngar 'dzin yod gsung don/ /gdags gzhi phung po yod gyur cing / der 'dzin sems pa yod ji srid / /bdag tu gdags pa'i rgyu tshang bas/ /'bras bu bdag 'dzin mi ldog gsungs/ /gang phyir rtag bdag spangs kyang ni/ /gdags gzhir brten nas btags pa'i bdag /lhan skyes zhen yul ma bkag phyir/ /ngar 'dzin skye la gegs med nyid/ /de phyir nyon mongs spang ba la/ /phung sogs stong par rtogs dgos zhes/ /'chad 12

pa lung 'di'i don min te/ /'di don 'di bzhin zla bas bkral/ /btags pa'i nga tsam shes gyur na/ /ngar 'dzin ldog la des chog ste/ /thag pa med par ma shes kyang / /sprul 'dzin sbrul med mthong bas ldog/mthar ni nges par rtogs dgos te/ /chos kun de nyid gcig yin cing / /de nyid mthong ba'i tshul gcig pas/ /mthar thug theg gcig 'grub pa yi/ /rigs pa klu sgrub yab sras smra/ /gal te khyod kyi lugs ltar na/ /de nyid nyan rang mthong zin pas/ /rigs pa de yis theg gcig tu/ /ci zhig 'grub ste dam bca' tsam/ /'dir ni zung 'jug ye shes gang / /mthar thug gzigs pa de kho na/ /de bzhin nyid gcig de yin te/ /'phags kun de la gzhol zhing 'bab / /des na tshul 'di legs rtogs na/ /klu sgrub lugs dang byams pa'i gzhung / /phan tshun bu ram sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /lhan cig yi gas bder 'ju yi/ /gzhan du mi 'phrod zas bzhin du/ /khong na mi bde'i skran gyur tshe/ /lung rigs gtsags bu rnon po brgya/ /gdengs shing 'debs la yid gting sdar/ /lta ba'i dngos gzhi skyong ba'i dus/ /kha cig ci yang mi 'dzin zer / /cir yang mi 'dzin zhes pa'i don/ /legs par rtogs dang log rtog gnyis/ /dang po mtha' bzhi'i spros bral te/ /'phags 13

pa'i ye shes kyi mdun na/ /gang yang gnas pa med mthong bas/ /'dzin stangs ngang gis zhig pa ste/ /stong gsal mkha' la lta dang mtshungs / /gnyis pa dran med hwa shang lugs/ /ma dpyad tse der bzhag pa yis/ /lhag mthong gsal ba'i cha med par/ /mtsho gting rdo bzhin tha mal gnas/ /dper na ci yang med ces pa/ /dbu mas med par mthong ba dang / /gzugs med med par mos pa ltar/ /tshig tsam mtshungs pa 'di dag kyang / /don la mi mtshungs gnam sa bzhin / /de ltar mtha' bzhi spros bral la/ /mtha' bzhi gang du'ang mi 'dzin na/ /mtha' bzhi las 'das 'dzin stangs zhig /med pas 'dzin stangs med par 'dod/ /gal te 'dzin stangs med ces pas / /blun po kha cig dang po nas/ /cir mi 'dzin par lhod do lo/ /'gro kun tha mal glod ches pas/ /khams gsum 'khor bar gtan 'khyams na/ /da dung bklags te bskul mi dgos/ /gal te de dag mi shes bzhin/ /bdag cag rang ngo shes zer na/ /don dam rang ngo shes pa la/ /bden stong phu thag chod pa dgos/ /'khrul snang bdag dang gzhan no zhes/ /sus kyang shes la sgom ci dgos/ /gal te sems la mdog dbyibs dang / /byung gnas 'gro sa brtag pa'i tshe/ /ma mthong stong par rtogs shes na/ /chos tshul shin tu zab pa ste/ /14

'di la'ang gol sa shin tu che/ /sems ni gzugs can ma yin pas/ /sus kyang mdog sogs mthong mi srid/ /ma mthong tsam la stong pa nyid / /ngo 'phrod snyam na shin tu gol/ /lan brgyar brtag kyang mi yi mgor / /phyugs kyi rwa co mthong mi srid/ /de ma mthong bas de stong par / /rtogs so zhe na sus kyang sla/ /des na rigs pa'i dpyad pa des /gnas lugs thig po zhig mthong na/ /sems de sgyu ma lta bu la/ /ngo bo bden med gting nas rig /de tshe thad ku'i nam mkha' la/ /bltas pa bzhin du rang gi sems/ /'gyu bzhin pa yang stong pa yi/ /nges shes kho thag chod pa dgos/ /yang ni khyod kyi sems de ni/ /med pa mkha' 'dra zhig 'dug gam/ /sna tshogs shes pa gang yin zer / /skad cig mi sdod g.yo ba'i sems/ /su la'ang yod phyir shes pa zhig /'dug par sus kyang nges par smra/ /de nas yod pa ma yin la/ /med pa'ang min pa'i sems de ni/ /'od gsal chos sku yin no zer/ /des kyang ngo 'phrod rlom pa bcas thos pa mang po ma byas kyang / /gcig shes kun grol shes so lo/ /rdzogs chen yod min med min ni/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral ba yin/ /khyod kyi 'di ni legs brtags na/ /yod par smra ru mi btub cing / /med par yang ni smrar med pa/ /don du yod med gnyis yin nam/ /yang na gnyis 15

ka min pa'i mu/ /gang rung zhig las ma 'das par/ /sems de yod min med min gyi/ /gzhi ru zhe la brnags kyin gda'/ /de ni bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag /de dang ming gi rnam grangs las/ /don la 'dod tshul khyad par med/ /sems dang de las gzhan gyi chos/ /kun kyang bden med nges pa'i steng / /snang ba rten 'byung du shar bas/ /yin min bsam brjod las 'das pa/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral ba'i gnad/ /gtad med zang ma thal byung ngo / /'di ni yin min gnyis bral zhes/ /blo yi mdun na 'bem bzhin gnas/ /bdag gzhan dngos 'dzin 'dir brten nas/ /srid pa'i chu bo brgyud mar 'jug /'di dag zlog pa'i gnyen po ni/ /bdag med pa yi 'dzin stangs yin/ /de yang med tshul ma shes par/ /med par mos pas mi phan te/ /thag khrar sbrul du 'khrul ba la/ /sprul med snyam pas mi phan kyang / /med tshul mthong na spangs pa bzhin/ /de phyir dpyad pas rtogs byas nas/ /dpyad tsam nyid du mi bzhag par/ /thog med dngos zhen goms ches pas/ /yang yang 'dzin stangs bcas te bsgom//bdag med goms pas bdag lta ba/ /drung nas 'byin phyir 'di dgos zhes/ /don gzigs du mas nan tan bsgrubs/ /dang po'i las can 'jug pa'i sgo/ /gol 'chug med pa 'di yin na/ /dang po 16

nas de spong zhes pa/ bdud kyi gsang tshig bkye ba yin/ /'dzin stangs des drangs bden stong la/ /nges shes mchog tu 'drongs pa'i tshe / /da gdod med 'dzin tsam po ni/ /gnas lugs mthar thug ma yin pas/ /sgro 'dogs so gnyis bral ba yi/ /spros bral stong pa chen po bsgom/ /bden stong phu thag chod gyur nas/ /stong pa rten 'byung shar ba yi/ snang stong cir yang mi 'dzin la/ /me yi kha nas dag pa'i gser / /ji bzhin yid ches rung mod kyi/ /gzhan du ches cher zab pa'i gnad/ /'phags bod mkhas grub che rnams kyis/ /yun ring 'bad de rtogs pa'i don/ /kye ma blun pos yud tsam la/ /rtogs par smra la the tshom g.yo/ /dngos gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kun/ /yod med las 'das don gyi gshis/ /yod med cir yang ma grub na/ /phyogs rer 'dzin pa spros dang bcas/ /de phyir rigs pas rnam dpyad tshe/ /cir yang grub pa ma mthong bas/ /cir yang 'dzin pa ga la skye/ /'on kyang mtha' bzhi'i spros bral tshul/ /dpyad pas drangs pa'i nges shes las/ /rang byung 'od gsal shes rab kyi/ /lhag mthong mar me bzhin du gsal/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal ba yi/ /mtha' bzhi'i blo ngan mun pa'i smag /drung 'byin gnyen po 'di yin pas / /nam bsgom nges shes skye ba dgos/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa 17

cig car du/ /khegs pa blo 'das gnyug ma'i dbyings/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa nyid na/ /cir phog tshul gyis mthong dka' bas/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa res 'jog tu/ /'gog pa tho sta bsam lta ba'i lugs/ /de la ji tsam goms pa bzhin/ /nges shes je bas je gsal nas/ /phyin log sgro 'dogs bsnubs byas pa'i/ /blo gros yar zla lta bur 'phel / /cir yang mi 'dzin lta ngan la/ /dngos po cir yang ma grub pa'i / /nges shes skye ba ga la yod/ /des na sgrib pa spong mi nus/ /de phyir 'di gnyis khyad par yang / /du ba'i rtags las me bzhin du/ /spang rtogs bogs skyed tshul las shes/ /gang phyir blun sgom tha mal pa / /spangs dang rtogs pa'i rgyu min la/ /yon tan skye ba'i gegs yin phyir/ /rgya ja tshags la drangs pa bzhin/ /lung rtogs 'grib cing nyon mongs 'phel/ /khyad par rgyu 'bras yid ches chung / /yang dag lta ba'i mig ldan na/ /sngar med lung dang nyams rtogs 'bar/ /stong mthong de yi yon tan las/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med la/ /yid ches nyon mongs chung bar 'gyur/ /dpyad pas nges shes drangs pa'i ngang / /rtse gcig bzhag pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /ma mthong mthong ba dam pa'i don/ /mthong don phyogs su ma lhung bas/ /cir yang bzung ba med mod kyi/ /lkugs pas bu ram myong ba ltar/ /yid ches 18

goms pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /skye yi dpyad pa kho na min/ /theg mchog lta ba bsgom pa la/ /dpyad dang 'jog pa gang 'thad na / /la las mi dpyad bzhag ste bsgoms/ /dpyad pas don la bsgribs pas na/ ma dpyad sbom por zhog dang zer/ /la las dpyad pa kho na byed/ /dpyad pa dang bral bsgom pa ni/ /gnyid du song ltar mi phan pas/ /nam yang dpyad pa dgos so zer/ /sgom pa dpyad 'jog mtha' gcig tu/ /phyogs rer 'dzin pa mi rung ste/ /ma dpyad pa yi 'jog sgom phal/ /zhi gnas tsam zhig 'grub srid kyang / /bsgoms pas nges shes mi skye bas/ /thar lam mig gcig nges shes nyid / /spangs nas sgrib pa bsal mi nus/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ma shes na/ /ci zhig bsgoms te tha mal gyi/ /rnam rtog bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /mig med lam du zhugs pa bzhin/ /thog med 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyis/ /rang bzhin log par zhen gyur pa/ /thabs tshul rigs pa brgya dag gis/ /'bad de ma brtag rtogs par dka'/ /gang phyir 'khrul snang zhen pa dang / /yang dag don mthong 'gal bas na / /ches goms srid pa'i smag rum 'dir/ /de nyid snang ba rnyed par dka'/ /sngon nas sbyangs pa'i las kyi 'phro/ /smin dang bla ma'i byin rlabs las/ /byung gnas 'gro 'ong tsam brtags pas/ /bden 19

stong nges pa srid mod kyi/ /de 'dra brgya lam res 'ga' ste/ /kun gyis de ltar rtogs mi nus/ /ka dag bdar sha chod pa la/ /thal 'gyur lta ba mthar phyin dgos/ /spros bral tsam gyi cha nas ni/ /de gnyis khyad par med do gsungs/ /stong par zhen pa bzlog phyir du/ /sngags las bde ba chen po bstan/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i dbyings / /yul dang yul can bral ba yi/ /tshul gyis nyams su myong bar byed/ /snang dang gsal dang rig pa gsum/ /bde ba de yi rnam grangs yin/ /snang cha gzugs kyi sku 'dis ni/ /srid pa ji srid phan bde yis/ /'gro kun skyobs par mdzad pas na/ /mthar thug snying rje'i rang bzhin nyid/ /de phyir rang bzhin nyid kyis kyang / /srid zhir mi gnas ye shes che/ /gzhi la ji ltar bzhugs pa ltar/ /bde stong lam gyi e waṃ gyis/ /bsgrubs pas tshe 'di nyid la yang / /zung 'jug 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum don du na/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i theg pa yi/ /'bras bu bzhi pa'i dbang gi lam / /rig stong rang byung ye shes nyid/ /kho na rtsal du bton gyur pa / /'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i lugs/ /mthar thug theg pa'i skyel so yin / /ji srid nges shes ma skyes bar/ /thabs dang dpyad pas nges shes drang / /nges shes skyes na de'i ngang du/ /nges shes nyid dang ma 20

bral bsgoms/ /nges shes mar me lta bu'i rgyun/ /yang dag min rtog snub med pa/ /de la rtag tu nan tan bya/ /bral na slar yang dpyad pas drangs/ /dang por dpyad pa gal che ste/ /dpyad pa bzang pos ma drangs na/ /nges shes bzang po ga la skye/ /nges shes bzang po ma skyes na/ /sgro 'dogs ngan pa ga la nub/ /sgro 'dogs ngan pa ma nub na/ /las rlung ngan pa ga la 'gag /las rlung ngan pa ma 'gag na / /'khor ba ngan pa ga la spong / /'khor ba ngan pa ma spang na/ /sdug bsngal ngan pa ci la 'dzad/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /don du bzang ngan yod ma yin/ /bzang ngan med par mnyam nyid du / /rtogs pa nges shes bzang po yin/ /nges shes bzang pos 'khor ba 'di/ /spangs nas myang 'das ma bsgrubs pas/ /'gal ba ltar snang tshig gi don/ /mi 'gal lam gyi gal mdo ste/ /lta spyod man ngag gnad gsang 'di/ /dpyad de don gyi ro myongs shig /bar du dpyad 'jog spel dgos te/ /dpyad na nges shes skye 'gyur zhing rka/ /ma dpyad tha mal zhen gyur tshe/ /dpyad cing dpyad cing nges shes drangs/ /nges shes skyes na de ga'i ngang / /ma yengs rtse gcig nyid du bsgoms/ /nges shes dang ni sgro 'dogs yid/ /phan tshun 'gal ba nyid kyi phyir/ /dpyad pas sgro 'dogs sun byung bas/ /21

nges shes gong nas gong du spel/ /tha mar dpyad pas ma drangs kyang / /nges shes ngang gis skye ba na/ /de ga'i ngang du 'jog pa las/ /dpyad pas grub zin bsgrub ci dgos/ /thag par sbrul med rtogs pa na/ /nges shes de gas sbrul 'dzin ldog /da rung sbrul ni med do zhes/ /yang yang dpyad zer blun min nam/ /'phags lam rtogs pa mngon gyur tshe/ /da rung dpyod pas mi bsgoms te/ /mngon sum rtogs la rgyu mtshan gyi/ /yid dpyod sbyor ba ci zhig dgos/ /gal te dpyad pa dang bral tshe/ /don mthong rtogs pa mi 'grub na/ /'phags dang rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /'jig rten gnod med shes pa yis/ /bzung rnams khyod la phyin ci log /nyid du thal te de dag ni/ /rtogs zin yin phyir de dag la/ /rang dus dpyad pa med pa'i phyir/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral ba yi/ /nges shes khyad par can gyi ngor/ /'di dang 'di'o snyam pa yi/ /dmigs gtad dpyod pa skabs mi thob/ /gang tshe dpyod pa'i mtshan 'dzin des/ /dar gyi srin bu ji bzhin du/ /rtogs pa de yis de bcings nas/ /yang dag don ji bzhin mi mthong / /nges shes khyad par can 'dis ni/ /yin lugs sgrib pa'i smag bsal tshe/ /gnyug ma don gyi 'od gsal ngang / /de nyid ma nor mthong ba gang / /so so rang gi ye shes te/ /sems byung shes 22

rab ga la yin/ /shes rab yul ni 'di'o zhes/ /rnam par 'byed cing der rtog la/ /gang phyir yul dang yul can dang / /snang stong re re gang du'ang / /mi dmigs mnyam pa'i ye shes 'di/ /sems dang sems las byung ba yi/ /mtshan nyid can du gnas ma yin/ /de phyir dpyad pas drangs pa yi/ /nges shes mchog la mnyam bzhag pa'i/ /shes rab dri ma med pa'i rgyus/ /'bras bu zung 'jug ye shes thob/ /lta ba gtan la phab pa dang / /nges pa'i grub mtha' sgrub byed pa/ /shan 'byed so sor rtogs pa yi/ /shes rab dri med tshad ma yin/ /des drangs pa yi nges shes kyi/ /lam nas yin lugs gshis phebs pa'i / /mnyam bzhag ye shes gang yin pa/ /theg chen lam gyi dngos gzhi de/ /'di dang ldan na zung 'jug gi /go 'phang tshe 'dir ster ba'i phyir/ /theg pa yin la chen po'ang yin/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lugs ltar na/ /bla med tshig dbang lam 'di ni/ /ye shes mthar thug yin mod kyi/ /logs su theg par ma bzhag kyang / /dper na mnyam nyid ye shes sku/ rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa yi/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug bzhed pa bzhin/ /bla med rgyud sde'i nang nas kyang / /dbang bzhi'i lam gyi ye shes gang / /rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa 'di/ /rgyud sde kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthil /23

lan grangs bcu drug bzhus pa'i gser/ /shin tu dag pa de bzhin du / /theg gzhan grub mthas dpyad pa yis/ /je bas je dag 'dir mthar phyin/ /de phyir shes rab dri med kyis/ /tshad mas 'di don grub pa'i tshul/ /rgyud dang dgongs pa 'grel kun dang / /chos bzang rigs pas rnam dpyad la/ /bsam na bdud kyi yul las 'das/ /mi 'phrog shes rab smin par byed/ /'on kyang lta ba'i dngos gzhi ni/ /snang stong phyogs rer 'dzin pa sogs/ /sems dang sems byung spyod yul du/ /'di don ston par byed pa ni/ /brjod min brjod byar byas pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs pa nyid dang 'gal/ /gang phyir a ti yo ga ni/ /snang stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /ye shes yin slad ma dag pa'i/ /sems las 'das pa kho na'i phyir/ /'di la ka dag stong pa'i cha/ /gtan 'bebs khregs chod lta ba dang / lhun grub sku dang ye shes kyi/ /rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs pa la/ /nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i skur/ /yid ches 'od gsal thod rgal gnyis/ /gnyis ku'ang so sor dbyer med de/ /ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug gi/ye shes chen po kho na yin/ /rgyud sde gzhan na mi shigs pa'i/ /ye shes ti la ka zhes pa/ /'di dang ming gi rnam grangs tsam/ /'dir ni shin tu gsal por bstan/ /rdzogs chen sems sde'i man ngag 24

rer / /mkhas grub so so'i nyams bzhes pas/ /phyag chen lam 'bras zhi byed dang / /zung 'jug dbu ma chen po sogs/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs so sor grags/ /don la sems las 'das pa yi/ /ye shes yin phyir kun kyang mnyam/ /sangs rgyas grub thob dgongs pa ni//gcig ces mkhas kun mgrin gcig smra/ /la las rang lugs rdzogs pa che/ /phyag chen sogs las 'phags so zer/ /ma rtogs lam gyi tha snyad med/ /rtogs na dgongs pa gcig pa la/ /rigs pas 'thad pa'i dbye ba med/ /de bzhin bla med rgyud kun gyi/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gi ye shes kun/ /rdzogs pa chen po dbye ba med/ /'on kyang de dag thams cad kyi/ /'byung gnas rdzogs chen rgyud sde la/ /sems klong man ngag sdes phye ba'i/ /zab rgyas khyad par 'phags pa'i gnad / /man ngag thor bu'i nyams len pa/ /gzhan la ma grags mang yod par/ /khyad chos yin zhes smra ci dgos/ /de la rdzogs chen mthar thug pa/ /zab zhi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yin na yang / /'dir ni gnas skabs lam dag tu/ /ye shes de dang rjes mthun pa/ /dpe dang don gyi zung 'jug rnams/ /ri mo bris pa'i zla ba dang / /chu zla nam mkha'i zla ba bzhin/ /rim pas gcig gis gcig 'dren pas/ /rang byung zag med ye shes gang / /25

rang gi blo nus dang bstun te/ /nyams su len pa yod nyid phyir/ /dper na 'phags lam ye shes gang / /thob phyir rjes mthun bsgom pa bzhin/ /chos nyid zung 'jug ye shes che/ /mngon sum gtan la phab pa na/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i lta ba kun/ /nges par nub nas spros bral mthong / /de phyir skabs shan ma phyed par/ /'dzin stangs yod med phyogs gcig tu/ /smra la skyon dang legs cha ste/ /zla ba'i 'phel 'grib bzhin du gnas/ /'di ni nges pa'i lung bzhin du / /rigs pa'i tshul gyis grub pa yin/ /bden pa gnyis las gang gtso na/ /kha cig don dam gtso cher 'dod / /kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i snang ba zhes/ /spang byar rtogs shing don dam pa/ /ma 'khrul yin pas don dam der/ /lta ba rnam dag yin no zer/ /kun rdzob ma 'khrul bden gyur na/ /don dam stong par mi rung phyir/ /de skad du ni gsungs mod kyi/ /kun rdzob spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /don dam 'ga' yang mi grub ste/ /de gnyis thabs dang thabs byung nyid/ /brtag bya'i dngos la ma brten par/de yi dngos med yod min te/ /des na dngos dang dngos med pa/ /gnyis ka rten 'brel tsam du mtshungs/ /gal te stong par zhen pa des / /snang ba rnam pa bcad gyur na/ /stong pa rten 'byung du shar 26

ba'i / /klu sgrub lugs bzang rnyog mar byas/ /stong mthong de yi lam goms nas/ /stong dbyings 'ba' zhig rtogs na ni/ /'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag stong pa nyid/ /dngos po'i 'jig rgyur khyod la'ang thal / /de phyir gdod nas stong na yang / /stong snang ris su ma chad pas / /stong pa kho na gtso che zhes/ /'dzin pa mthar thug don mi mkhas / /la las don dam phar bcad nas(rnying ma pa phal cher mchan)ske/ /kun rdzob tsam gyi ngos nas ni/ /rgyud sde'i lta ba mtho dman byed/ /don dam stong pas ma zin pa'i/ /kun rdzob rang nyid lta ba yi/ /mtho dman byed chos su mi 'thad/ /don dam gdeng dang mi ldan par/ /kun rdzob lha ru bsgom pa tsam/ /mos pa tsam yin lta ba min/ /mu stegs rig sngags 'ga' zhig kyang / /bzla tshe rang nyid gzhan du mos/ /la las kun rdzob gal che ste/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug dgos zer/ /yang yang kun rdzob phyogs la bsngags/ /zung 'jug lta ba skyong dus na/ /zung 'jug dor nas med rkyang 'dzin//bshad pa bzang po ma yi rjes/ /nyams len bu chung sleb ma nus/ /des na snga 'gyur ring lugs 'dir/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos skad la / /rtag dang mi rtag bden gnyis sogs/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba yi/ /zung 'jug kho na'i grub mtha' skyong / /kun rdzob dang 27

ni don dam pa/ /ya bral re re'i steng du ni/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu bzhag mi nus/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum char du'ang / /'di spang 'di blang dbye ba med/ /kun rdzob spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /don dam med la don dam pa/ /spangs pa'i kun rdzob gzhan med nyid/ /gang snang stong pas khyab pa dang / /gang stong snang bas khyab pa ste/ /snang na mi stong mi srid cing / /stong de'ang ma snang mi grub phyir/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis po yang / /stong gzhir byas nas stong dgos phyir/ /snang kun btags pa tsam zhig la/ /stong pa'ang blo yis btags pa tsam/ /rig pas dpyad pa'i nges shes la/ /'di gnyis thabs dang thabs byung ste/ /gcig yod na ni gcig med pa/ /mi srid 'du 'bral med par gnas/ /de phyir snang dang stong pa dag /so so'i char ni shes na yang / /don du nam yang dbye ba med/ /de phyir zung 'jug ces brjod do/ /gnas lugs mthong ba'i nges shes ni/ /gang mthar lhung ba med phyir ro/ /yang dag dpyod pa'i shes rab ngor/ /snang dang stong pa 'di gnyis po/ /yod mnyam med mnyam ngo bo gcig /ldog pa tha dad dbye bar 'dod/ /de yang dang po'i las can la/ /dgag bya 'gog byed lta bur snang / /de tshe gcig tu 'dres pa med/ /nam 28

zhig stong pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /snang bar 'char la yid ches thob/ /de yang gdod nas stong pa dang / /snang ba 'di dag stong pa yis/ /stong bzhin snang la snang bzhin du/ /stong mthong nges shes skye ba nyid/ /'di ni mdo rgyud man ngag gi /lam zab kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod pa'i don/ /yang dag lta ba 'khrul med yin/ /gnad de je bas je zab tu/ /rtogs pas kun rdzob snang ba yang / /rang mtshan zhen pa rim spong bas/ /rgyud sde'i theg rim de ltar snang / /yid kyis mos bsgom tsam zhig dang / /snod bcud lhar snang nges shes kyis/ /lta ba gdengs su gyur pa gnyis/ /mtshungs pa'i go skabs mi srid de/ /dbu mas chos rnams bden stong du/ /nges pa gang de lta yin la/ /bram zes nad la sngags 'debs tshe/ /nad med mos pa lta min bzhin/ /don dam gnas lugs rtogs pa yis/ /kun rdzob lha ru yid ches kyi/ /gzhan du 'khrul ba'i snang tshul la/ /gnas nas lha ru ji ltar 'grub/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang 'di min pa'i / /'khor ba zhes bya gzhan du med/ /de spong lam gyi dbye ba rnams / /don dam kho na'i ngos nas min/ /don dam tshul gcig nyid yin phyir/ /chos can kun rdzob snang ba'i cha/ /don dam gshis su mthong goms kyi/ /blo nus la brten bya ba dang / /cha mnyam rnal 29

'byor bla med bstan/ /des na bden gnyis so so yis/ /rgyud sde'i mtho dman mi byed kyang / /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa la/ /ci tsam yid ches thob pa bzhin/ /nyams len de yi rjes su 'brang / /de phyir bla med rdo rje'i theg /tshe gcig grol ba ster ba'i lam ma nor ji bzhin nyams len na/ /mi gcig 'gro bas tha dad par/ /mthong ba'i chu yis dpe bzhin du/ /dag pa'i gzigs pa la brten nas / /snang srid gzhir gzhengs dkyil 'khor du/ /su zhig yid mi ches par 'gyur/ /gal te de ltar ma shes nas/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin ma dag pa/ /'dod bzhin lha ru bsgoms pas kyang / /ngan skyug bum par dri bzang gis/ /byugs pa dang 'drar sems pa des/ /kye ma mnyam nyid rdo rje'i theg /sgom pa ri mo'i mar me bzhin/ /snang tshul ma dag par snang yang / /de ni 'khrul bas grub pa'i mtha'/ /gnas tshul yang dag gzigs pa'i don/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i grub mthar smra / /snod bcud dag pa'i rten brten par/ /min no snyam du lta bzhin du/ /yin no snyam pa'i sgom pa gang / /'gal 'du'i rang rtags ngoms pa la/ /lam de lam gyi gzugs brnyan nyid/ /sol ba bkrus pas mi dkar bzhin/ /min kyang yin snyam bcos sgom gyis/ /'bras 4bu thob par 'gyur na ni/ /bden stong nges shes med bzhin 30

du / /mu stegs nyi ma pa rnams kyis/ /snang ba spangs pas stong pa sogs / /bsgoms pas nyon mongs spong bar 'gyur/ /bya spyod bla med rgyud sde la/ /lta ba'i mtho dman med gyur na/ /snang srid dag mnyam rtogs pa yi/ /lta ba gdengs su gyur bzhin du/ /bdag dang lha la bzang ngan dang / /gtsang dang mi gtsang so sor ni/ /ma mthong bzhin du dbye ba ni/ /rang gis rang la gnod par zad/ /yang na rgyud sde 'og ma bzhin/ blang dor nyid du zhen bzhin du/ /bla med sbyor sgrol sha chang sogs/ /blang dor mnyam pa nyid spyod pa/ /ma rtogs tho co'i spyod pa zhes/ /smad par gyur pa de min nam/ /ji ltar ji ltar gnas lugs don/ /mthong ba'i nges shes lta bar brjod / /lta bas ji ltar thag bcad pa/ /de bzhin sgom dang spyod pas skyong / /theg pa lta ba'i mtho dman gyis/ /'byed phyir dgur ma nges she na/ /nang pa'i grub mtha' dma' shos nas/ /mthar phyin rdo rje rtse mo'i bar/ /sde tshan dgu yi grangs su ni/ /'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod phyir te/ /theg pa mtho dman mang yod kyang / /gsum sogs dgos pas bzhag bzhin no/ /des na nang gi ye shes stobs/ /ji lta ji ltar stobs 'phel ba/ /de lta de ltar snod bcud rnams/ /dag dang ma dag so sor mthong / /de phyir snang stong dbyer med gzhi/ /31

bden gnyis dbyer med tshul gyis rtogs/ /lam de ji bzhin goms pa las/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug ye shes thob/ /chu gcig 'gro ba so so la/ /mi gcig dngos po snang ba'i tshe/ /la las thun mong blta bya de/ /chu yin de mthong yul can rnams/ /kun kyang tshad ma yin zhes zer/ /chu la rang bzhin 'ga' yod na/ /tshad ma tshad min mi srid cing / /so so'i yul snang mthun min na/ /ka bum mthong ba'i blo bzhin du/ /thun mong blta bya mi srid 'gyur/ /la las rlan gsher tsam yin zer/ /thun mong so sor rlan gsher tsam / /ma log yod na rlan gsher la/ /mi gcig mthong snang mang byung zhing / /gcig mthong gcig la med pa yi/ /chu dang rnag sogs gzhi de gang / /gzhan yang nam mkha' mtha' yas par/ /rlan gsher gzhi ru ga la 'gyur/ /rlan gsher chu dang gcig yin na/ /rnag sogs nyid du snang mi rung / /chu la sogs las tha dad du/ /rlan gsher ci yang dmigs pa min/ /mi gcig mthong snang so so la/ /thun mong blta bya mi srid cing / /thun mong mthun pa'i dngos po la/ /so sor snang ba mi srid phyir/ /ltos nas bzhag pa tsam zhig las/ /dpyad pa'i gzhi zhig khas len na/ /gnas lugs yin par grub dgos pas/ /gang ltar brtags kyang mi 'thad nyid/ /thun mong lta 32

bya med gyur na/ /sems tsam bzhin du yul med par/ /shes nyid yul du khas len dgos/ /de ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ /yul med bzhin du 'dzin pa yang / /don la med par 'dra ba la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis po'ang kun rdzob tu/ /snang bar mnyam phyir gang snang ba//de la brtags nas gzung 'dzin gnyis/ /yod med phye ba mi 'thad de / /yul snang yod kyang rdzun pa ltar/ /'dzin pa snang yang ma grub phyir / /snang tsam thun mong blta bya ni/ /mthun par snang dang mi snang gzhir / /yod par grub phyir de med par/ /mi rung zlos gar mthong sogs bzhin/ /yod tsam 'di las ma gtogs pa'i/ /yod pa gzhan nas mi srid pas/ /'di med na ni snang ba kun/ /mi snang nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur/ /phyi dang nang gi rkyen gyi ni/ /don dngos ji bzhin mi mthong ba/ /sgyu ma'i sngags kyis shing bu la/ /rta dang glang por snang ba bzhin/ /de phyir thun mong blta bya ni/ /'di zhes nges par bzhag mi rung / /des na rang gi lugs la ni/ /snang stong ris su ma chad pa'i/ /gzhi nyid cir yang ma grub pa/ /gang snang kun la mnyam pa'i phyir/ /dngos gcig sna tshogs par yang snang / /gang la snang stong rung ba na/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ /gang la snang stong mi rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung mi 'gyur/ /'o na tshad ma 33

tshad min gyi/ /rnam dbye'ang 'thad pa med ce na/ /gang snang de nyid gzhan nyid du/ /ma snang de phyir tshul mthong des/ /gzhal bya mi grub ma yin te/ /gang phyir dngos kun rang bzhin gyis/ /rang rang ngo bo la gnas pa/ /gcig dang tha dad byar rung ba'i/ /tshad ma grub pa nyid kyi phyir/ /de phyir ltos te tshad ma nyid/ /grub kyi rang dbang chos rnams ni/ /tshad mas grub pa ma yin te/ /grub na gnas lugs nyid du thal/ /chu gcig po yang rang 'dzin gyis/ /tshad mas grub kyang ltos med du/ /rang dbang kho nas grub min te/ /don dam dpyod pas mi grub cing / /yi dwags ngor yang grub mi 'gyur/ /rang 'dzin yul la mngon sum dang / /rjes dpag tshad mas nges pa na/ /de yul 'jug ldog mi bslu'i phyir/ /tshad ma don med ma yin no/ /dper na chu gcig la zhes pa/ /mi yi mthong ba la ltos nas/ /bzhag ste lha la ltos na ni/ /bdud rtsi gcig la blta gzhir 'dzin/ /chu la rnag chu bdud rtsi ru/ /mthong tshe gsum ka tshogs min la/ /de gsum gcig kyang tshad min na/ /de las dngos po gzhan zhig tu/ /mthong ba tshad mas sgrub mi nus/ /mthong don gsum ka med 'gyur bas / /mis mthong chu 'di chu min na/ /gzhan zhig chu ru mi 'thad pas / /chu zhes bya ba gtan med 'gyur/ /de lta'i lugs la'ang tshad 34

ma yi/ /rnam bzhag 'thad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu yis/ /ma bslad dbang po'i yul de nyid/ /tshad ma yin par bsgrub dgos te/ /chu dang smig rgyur chur snang bzhin/ /des na gnas skabs yi dwags nyid/ /las kyi sgrib pas chu gtsang ma/ /rnag tu snang yang skyon sel na/ /da gdod chu ru snang ba'i phyir/ /re zhig chu ni tshad mar bsgrubs/ /mthar thug rigs pas dpyad pas na/ /de kun bag chags snang ba ste/ /gzhan du chu nyid dag pa yi/ /zhing dang sku yang snang ba'i phyir/ /mi yis mthong ba de kho na/ /mtha' gcig tshad mar rung ma yin/ /des na sgrib rkyen je dag pas/ /mthong ba 'og ma la ltos nas/ /gong ma gong ma tshad ma ru/ /khas blang ba ni 'thad pa nyid/ /mthar thug de kho na nyid ni/ /gcig las med phyir de kho na/ /mthong ba'i tshad ma'ang gcig yin te/ /tshad ma gnyis pa mi srid do/ /gnas lugs bden gcig zung 'jug ste spyo/ /tshad ma rang byung ye shes nyid/ /spangs bya ma rig gcig pu las / /med phyir rig dang ma rig tsam/ /de phyir tshad ma'i tshul 'di yis / /snang kun rang bzhin lhar sgrub pa/ /snga 'gyur rang lugs kho na ste/ /kun mkhyen rong zom paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /legs bshad seng ge'i nga ro yin/ /gzhan na lugs 'di tshul bzhin du/ /smra ba med pas 'di 35

yi thad/ /gang ltar khas blang 'gal bar mthong / /de la thun mong blta bya de/ /snang stong re re mi rung ste/ /gal te stong pa tsam yin na / /'gro ba su yang rung la yang / /mkha' yang bum par snang 'gyur zhing / /bum pa mkha' ltar snang mi 'gyur/ /snang ba dang bral stong pa tsam/ /blta byar rung na ci mi snang / /dngos rnams rtag tu yod pa'am/ /med par thal te rgyu med la/ /ji skad brjod kun 'di la mtshungs/ /stong pa'i gnas skabs yin bzhin du/ /snang med de gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ /ma stong pa zhig yod na ni/ /stong tsam snang gzhir bzhag dang 'gal/ /'o na khyod kyi gong du ni/ /stong snang mi 'gal ci zhe na/ /'dir ni mthong don tha snyad pa'i/ /tshad ma'i rnam bzhag skabs yin pas/ /de'i ngor yod med 'gal ba ste/ /dngos gcig steng gi bden pa gnyis/ /mi 'gal ye shes yul yin phyir / /gal te stong pa dang bral ba'i/ snang tsam snang gzhir mi rung ste / /snang de gang ltar snang ba yin/ /'di zhes ris su ma chad pa'i/ /snang ba bsam par mi nus phyir/ snang gzhir 'grub pa ma yin te/ /shes byed tshad mas ma mthong bzhin/ /yod ces dam bca' tsam du zad / /gang snang ris su chad gyur na/ /de las gzhan du snang mi rung / /mi stong snang ba yin phyir yang / /de nyid rigs pas dpyad 36

bzod 'gyur/ /chu rnag bdud rtsi sogs kyi gzhi/ /de gsum gang yin kyang 'gal te/ /gal te chu de rnag yin na/ /chu ru snang ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /gal te rnag min chu yin na/ /rnag sogs gzhan du ci la snang / /yi dwags yul du snang de yang / /chu yin zhe na rnag snang yang / /med par khas blang nyid du thal/ /gang phyir rang la snang de las / /snang gzhi logs su yod min te/ /yod na tha dad du 'gyur phyir / /ka bum gcig gzhi gcig min bzhin/ /des na snang stong zung 'jug gam/ /bden stong snang ba tsam zhig de/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba yi/ /zung 'jug ro mnyam chen po ru/ /chos kun gdod nas mnyam pa'i phyir/ /mnyam nyid rdzogs pa chen po ru/ /grub don gtan la phab byas nas/ /tshul de goms pa'i lam gyi skabs / /dag pa'i gzigs pa la brten nas/ /ma dag snang ba rang grol ba'i/ /snang srid dag pa'i chos sku zhes/ /yid ches rdo rje'i lung don 'byor/ /des na sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /phung lnga sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /snang ba ris su ma chad pa/ /de nyid dag pa'i lha snang zhes/ /dgongs pa'i don la yid ches nyid/ /'di ltar rnag 'dzin las zlog tshe/ /'khrul bar rtogs shing de goms pas/ /de la chu ru snang ba nyid/ /dag pa'i rgyal sras chen po yis/ /chu yi rdul rer grangs med zhing / /37

mthong zhing chu de mā ma kyir/ /mngon sum snang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /mthar thug sgrib gnyis spang ba'i sar/ /zung 'jug ro mnyam chen por gzigs / /de phyir dag pa'i gzigs pa ni/ /sgrib pa ma lus spangs pa'i phyir/ /dngos po'i gnas tshul ma nor ba/ /de yis mthong ba kho na las/ /gzhan du yod pa ma yin na/ /de nyid mthar thug tshad ma ru / /bzung ste 'di kun gdod nas kyang / /dag pa'i chos skur gnas so zhes/ /dam bca' grub pa'i rtse mo ru/ /rigs pa'i mig ldan rnams la grub/ /de lta na yang theg pa de/ /ngo mtshar 'od zer stong mnga' bas/ /dman pa'i yid can 'byung po'i bya/ /phal cher long ba lta bur 'gyur/ /de la mthar thug mnyam nyid dbyings/ /lha snang kho nar snang ngo zhes/ /phyogs gcig sgrub par mi nus kyang / /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa yi/ /dbyings dang snang cha ye shes sku/ /'du 'bral med phyir snang ba'i cha/ /gdod nas lha ru dag pa la/ /gnas lugs dpyad pas kyang mi gnod/ /gang phyir sgrib gnyis spangs pa yi/ /snang stong zung 'jug dbyings de ni/ /mthar thug de kho na nyid yin/ /de las gzhan du gang ltar du/ /rtogs kyang mthar thug don min te/ /sgrib gnyis zad par ma spangs pas/ /gnas snang rnam kun mi mthun phyir/ /gnas skabs lam gyi snang ba la/ /mig 38

skyon dag pa'i rab rib bzhin/ /yul can dri mas dag pa las/ /yul kyang de bzhin dag mthong ste/ /yul can dag kyang logs shig na / /yul de ma dag med pa'i phyir/ /de lta na yang gang zag gcig /'tshang rgya de tshe ma dag dngos/ /gzhan la mi snang mi 'gyur te/ /rang snang sgrib pas rang bsgribs phyir/ /des na yul dang yul can rnams//rang bzhin gdod nas dag na yang / /glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa'i phyir / /dri ma sbyang la 'bad par bya/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma rnams kyang ni/ /rang gi ngo bos dag pa las/ /logs shig ma dag pa min pas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid/ de ltar snang tshul sna tshogs pa/ /ma rtogs dus na so sor 'dzin/ /byis pa gang la sems chags pa/ /de ni byis pa rmongs pa ste/ /rmongs pa de yis 'ching bar byed/ /rtogs na kun kyang ro mnyam gyi/ /ngang du 'bras bu'i btsan sa zin/ /dus gsum dus med gnyug ma'i klong / /rang byung ye shes rgyal bar 'gyur / /dag mnyam chen po khas len pa'i/ /tshul 'di legs par grub pa ste/ /snang stong cir yang ma grub pas/ /cir yang rung la cir yang snang / /de las gzhan du gang btags pa/ /cir yang mi rung cir mi snang / /tshul 'di'i yid ches rnyed pa'i sgo/ /stong dang rten 'byung lam yin te/ /snang stong 'di la nges shes na/ /bri gang 39

bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /srid pa stong dang mi stong sogs/ /chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab la/ /zab mo'i bzod pa khong nas skye/ /rdul gcig khyon la rdul snyed zhing / /mthong zhing skad cig yun la yang / /bskal par snang ste dngos po rnams/ /bden stong sgyu ma'i nges shes kyis / /sangs rgyas spyod yul nyid la 'jug /de phyir rang snang ris med dang / /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba dang / /gzhi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /chos nyid cir yang ma grub dang / /snang stong zung du 'jug pa sogs/ /grub mtha'i chos skad tsam 'di'i don/ /lo brgyar bsgrims te bsam byas kyang / /sngon goms smin pa'i rgyud med na / /blo chen sbyangs pa mi dman mod/ /thugs su chud pa ma yin no/ /de phyir grub mtha' mtha' dag gi /gting phug gang du gzhol ba yi/ /brgya phrag chos kyi legs bshad klung / /'bab pa'i mtsho chen 'di rmad byung / /snang tshul gzhan rnams ma nges shing / /'gyur ba dag dang bcas te snang / /mthar phyin zung 'jug ye shes ni/ /bslu med don gzigs 'gyur ba med/ /spros bral dbu ma chen po la/ /khas len yod med dpyad pa'i tshe/ /snga rabs pa rnams mgrin gcig tu/ /dbu ma'i rang lugs yin min dang —/ /yod med la sogs cir yang ni/ /med phyir khas len med 40

par 'dod/ /rang gzhung rnams las lam 'bras dang / /rten 'byung grub mtha'i rnam bzhag kun/ /khas blang rang lugs yod bzhin du/ /tha snyad thams cad gzhan ngo la/ /skyel ba tshig don gnyis kur 'gal/ /klong chen rab 'byams 'di skad du/ /dbu mar khas len yod med la/ /snga rabs pa rnams phyogs rer 'dzin/ /lugs rer skyon yon gnyis re gnas/ /des na rang gis bzhed pa la / /don dam gnas lugs gzhal ba'i tshe/ /gshis la cir yang ma grub ltar/ /khas kyang ci zhig len par byed/ /de phyir grub mtha' gnas lugs kyi/ /khas len yin phyir rtsod sogs tshe/ /gshis bzhin khas len ci yang med/ /rjes thob lam 'bras grub pa'i mtha'//ji ltar ji snyed rnam bzhag rnams/ /ma 'dres so sor khas len 'dod / /phyin chad tshul 'di smra shes na/ /kho bo'i legs bshad mthu yin gsungs/ /der brten gangs can mkhas pa 'gas/ /rang lugs khas len yod pa'i phyogs/ /kho na yang yang ches cher bsgrubs//de yang skabs shan ma phyes na/ /gshis don cir yang ma grub phyir/ /mtha' gcig khas len yod pa'ang dka'/ /dbu ma rang gi lugs zhes pa/ /dbu ma'i grub mtha' mthar thug don/ /ji ltar gzhal nyid yin dgos te/ /de las gzhan pa rang lugs min/ /ci slad 41

dbu ma rang gis ni/ /gzhal na de ma grub phyir ro/ /des na des khas blangs yin na/ /rang dbang dpyad nas khas blang bar/ /rigs pas 'phul nus nyid kyi phyir/ /khas blangs pa de don dam par / /grub cing dpyad bzod nyid du 'gyur/ /rang lugs khas len ma yin na/ /rang la khas len yod pa 'gal/ /rang la dpyad dang ma dpyad pa'i/ /khas len gnyis ni yod gyur cing / /gnyis ka nges par bden gyur na/ /rang lugs zhes pa de gnyis po/ /re re yin nam gnyis ka yin/ /re re yin na gcig shos 'gal/ /yod pa khas blangs ma yin la/ /med par khas ni blangs gyur na/ /yod ces bya ba'i khas len ni/ /kun rdzob tu yang mi rung ste/ /med pa kho na khas blang phyir/ /gnyis ka rang gi khas blangs na/ /dpyad mi bzod pa bsam nas su/ /rigs pas gnod med khas len pa/ /min phyir gnyis ka dpyad bzod 'gyur/ /de lta na yang de gnyis po/ /tshogs pa srid pa ma yin te/ /tshogs na dpyad pas rtogs na yang / /ma dpyad dus bzhin yod rtogs nyid/ /yod phyir dpyad pas ci zhig gnas / /kun rdzob dpyad grub rigs ma yin/ /dgag bya bcad pa'i med dgag las/ /lhag pa'i gnas lugs med gyur na/ /'dzin stangs de la snang ba'i cha/ /skabs mi thob phyir mtha' gcig tu/ /42

lta sgom spyod pa'i skabs kun kyang / /med par lta ba'i yid can du/ /ci phyir mi 'gyur gnas lugs dang / /rjes mthun nam yang goms dgos phyir/ /des na kun mkhyen bzhed pa bzhin/ /rang lugs 'di ltar shes par bya/ /dbu ma mtshan nyid pa yin na/ /zung 'jug dbu ma chen po'am/ /spros bral dbu ma yin dgos te/ /'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes dang / /rjes su mthun par gtan phabs nas/ /yod med la sogs mtha' rnams kun/ /nyer zhi'i rang bzhin yin phyir ro/ /stong pa 'ba' zhig yul byed pa'i/ /lam de bden gnyis phyogs gcig la/ /ltung phyir nyi tshe'i lta ba de/ /zung 'jug dang ni spros bral min/ /zung 'jug yod dang med pa'am/ /snang dang stong pa mnyam nyid kyang / /'di ni don dam stong pa'i dbyings / /'ba' zhig yul can yin phyir ro/ /spros pa yod med la sogs pa'i/ /dmigs pa'i rnam pa thams cad de/ /'di ni med pa'i spros pa dang / /ma bral de la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /des na dbu ma chen po'i ngor/ /khas len ci yang yod min te/ /de yis snang stong mnyam nyid du/ /rtogs slad yod med yin min sogs/ /dgag sgrub spros kun bral bas na/ /gnas lugs don bzhin chos kun kyang / /khas blang rigs pas mi grub phyir/ /gang du khas ni len mi 43

byed / /de ltar gnas lugs mthar thug don/ /khas len med kyang snang tshul la/ /tha snyad bden gnyis so sor yang / /khas blang yod de de gnyis kyang / /bden gnyis dbyer med gnas lugs la/ /ltos na so so'i snang chul tsam/ /dbyer med don mthong ye shes la/ /ltos na tshad ma gnyis po yang / /nyi tshe'i gnas yin de gcig gis/ /bden gnyis 'dzin pa mi srid phyir/ /des na tha snyad don dam gyi/ /tshad ma gnyis po shes rab ste/ /bum sogs de gnyis kyis gzhal na/ /ngo bo gnyis ni rnyed na yang / /gcig tshe gcig ni yod min pas/ /so skye'i blo la bden pa gnyis/ /res 'jog tshul las mi snang phyir/ /so so gzhal ba'i khas len gnyis/ /yod pa nyid du grub pa yin/ /'o na khas len yod med dang / /bden gnyis khas len nang 'gal tshul/ /gong du gzhan la ji brjod pa/ /rang la'ang mtshungs par thal zhe na/ /nged kyis khyad par phyes nas su/ /shan 'byed lam gyi dbu ma dang / /dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag dbu ma gnyis/ /rags dang phra ba'am rgyu 'bras sam/ /rnam shes ye shes gnas skabs kyi/ /dbu ma che chung khyad phyes nas/ /bshad phyir skyon de ga la 'jug /des na dbu ma chen po la/ /khas len med pa rang gi lugs/ /mthar thug de yin rjes thob la/ /bden gnyis so sor snang ba'i tshe/ /bden gnyis so 44

so'i tshad ma yis/ /gzhal ba'i dgag sgrub thams cad kyang / /log rtog re re dgag pa'i ched/ /yin gyi gshis la dgag sgrub tu/ /khas blang gang yang med pa'i phyir/ /gshis la bden pa gnyis po yang / /ris su chad pa yang med pas/ /khas len gnyis po gang ltar yang / /bden par grub pa med pa'i phyir/ /gnyis kur yang ni khas blangs kyang / /snang tshul tsam gyi dbang phyir dang / /gnas skabs gnyis ka so so na/ /bden de 'gal ba med pa'i phyir/ /dpyad bzod la sogs skyon mi 'bab/ /dngos po'ang dpyad pa mi bzod de/dngos med kyang ni dpyad mi bzod/ /mthar thug gnyis ka mtshungs pa la/ /gnas skabs ltos te btags pa tsam/ /ma brtags grags pas yod tsam de/ /snang tshul yin gyis gnas tshul min/ /bden med dpyod pa'i rig shes kyis/ /mthong ba gnas tshul don dam 'dod / /de yang kun rdzob la ltos pa'i/ /don dam yin gyi mthar thug la/ /ltos na don dam rnam grangs tsam/ /gnas snang phan tshun 'gal ba na/ /bden gnyis tha dad skyon bzhi 'bab/ /gnas snang phan tshun gzhan min na/ /bden gnyis gcig pa'i skyon bzhis gnod / /tshul des sangs rgyas sems can kyang / /gnas tshul snang tshul tsam yin gyi/ /rgyu 'bras nyid du 'dod pa ni/ /theg pa chung 45

ngur shes par bya/ /gnas snang gcig dang tha dad du/ /khas blangs med phyir sems can ni/ /sangs rgyas yin na snang rung dang / /lam dang sgrub pa don med dang / /rgyu la 'bras gnas khas len sogs/ /rigs pas gnod pa rnam kun med/ /gnas tshul gang yin sgrib pa yis / /bsgribs phyir nye bar mi snang bas/ /lam la 'bad par byed pa ni/ /rang gzhan gnyis gas 'dod pa nyid/ /bden gnyis 'gal ba med pa'i phyir/ /yod dang med ces lta ba yi/ /khas len gnyis po'ang ji ltar 'gal/ /phan tshun gcig pa'ang min pa'i phyir/ /khas blang gnyis kyi rnam par bzhag /de phyir ji srid bden pa gnyis / /so sor snang ba dang bcas pa'i/ /sems kyi 'jug pa yod kyi bar/ /de gnyis rnam kun stobs mtshungs pas/ /mtha' gcig khas len yod min te/ /med ces bden stong nges pa dang / /yod ces snang cha nges pa gnyis/ /res 'jog tshad ma gnyis kyis ni/ /gzhal tshe so sos rnyed don nam/ /mthong don bden pa gnyis zhes brjod / /de gnyis gcig dang tha dad pa/ /min phyir de gnyis mtha' gcig tu/ /gcig spang gcig ni bzung mi rung / /de gnyis la dpyod shes rab kyis/ /khas len so sor phye ste dper/ /mthar thug chos sku 'thob pa'i tshe/ /sems dang sems byung ma lus pa/ /tha snyad 46

dbang du 'gag ces bya/ /dam pa'i don du 'gag pa'ang med/ /mdo dang bstan bcos gzhung kun na/ /dgag sgrub rnam pa ji snyed pa / /la la don dam khas len te/ /la la kun rdzob dbang du gsungs / /don dam kho na'i dbang du na/ /lam dang sangs rgyas sems can sogs/ /med ces smra bar rung mod kyi/ /kun rdzob nyid la ltos med du/ /de gcig kho nar mi 'gyur te/ /med kyang 'khor 'das snang cha kun/ /snang bar mngon sum grub pa'i phyir/ /tha snyad tshad ma'i dbang byas nas/ /lam dang sangs rgyas sems can sogs/ /yod ces brjod par rigs mod kyi/ /don dam nyid la ltos med du/ /de gcig kho nar mi 'gyur te/ /yod kyang de ltar ma grub par/ /dpyad pa tshad mas nges pa'i phyir/ /des na de gnyis nam du yang / /gcig med gcig yod srid ma yin/ /gnyis ka stobs mtshungs bden gyur tshe/ /dngos po mi stong 'gyur zhe na/ /gnyis ku'ang rang bzhin ma grub dang / /yul gnyis don gyis tha dad pa/ /ma yin snang ba de'i ngo bo/ /stong phyir mi stong ga la yin/ /gnyis ka mtshungs par snang de'i phyir/ /stong par grub ste snang med na/ /stong pa'ang ci yis shes par 'gyur/ /des na gnyis ka mi 'gal bar/ /phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'char zhing / /gcig yod gcig la nges shes na/ /nam 47

yang 'du 'bral med pa'am/ /gang la gang gis ma khyab pa/ /med phyir gang ltar gzhal kyang bden/ /snang ba stong par shes pa yis/ /snang ba bden pa med par rtogs/ /stong pa snang bar shes na yang / /stong pa bden par yod mi rtogs/ /de phyir 'du 'bral med mthong tshe / /bden par nam yang slar mi ldog /gang snang de yi gnas lugs ni/ /stong pa yin phyir 'du 'bral med/ /snang ba spang ba'i pha rol tu/ /stong pa yan gar mi 'grub phyir/ /des na ji srid res 'jog gis/ /bden gnyis bsgom pa shes rab ste/ /gnyis snang 'khor ba'i skabs 'di na/ /sems dang sems byung g.yo ba yis /ye shes nye bar mi snang phyir/ /dpyad pa'i shes rab dri med gnyis/ /spang blang med par gzung bya ste/ /gang tshe gcig ma tshang gyur na/ /de gnyis las byung zung 'jug gi /ye shes nges par mi skye ste/ /gtsub shing gtsub gtan gang rung dang / /bral ba'i me ni 'byung min bzhin//des na thabs dang stong pa nyid/ /ya bral yang dag lam min zhes/ /rgyal dang brgyud 'dzin gyis gsungs phyir/ /rgyu gnyis 'di spang ye shes che/ /skye ba'i thabs gzhan mi srid de/ /ye shes rang gi ngo bo ni/ /bsam brjod 'das phyir brda thabs dang / /tshig tsam dag gis mtshon pa las/ /dngos su bstan par mi nus pas/ /sngags su tshig dbang 48

zhes gsungs te/ /rdo rje snying po'i rgyud sogs su/ /tshig dang thabs kyi sgo nas bstan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes te/ /de ltar gzhan la ma ltos par/ /gzung bar nus pa ma yin pa'i/ /bden gnyis lam gyi dbu ma bstan/ /bden gnyis tshul gyis dpyad pa'i 'bras / /zung 'jug nyid du grub nus pa/ /des na bden gnyis gtan 'bebs tshe/ /snang stong dgag bya 'gog byed kyi/ /tshul du res 'jog lta bur bstan/ /de 'bras zung 'jug ye shes nyid/ /rgyud sder rnam grangs du mas bstan/ /des na dbu ma'i lugs thams cad / /bden gnyis tshul gyis rnam par bzhag /bden pa gnyis la ma brten par/ /zung 'jug khong du chud mi 'gyur/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa yang / /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /de phyir bden gnyis so so yi/ /khas len dang bcas dbu ma de/ /'bras ming rgyu la btags pa yi/ /res 'jog dbu ma chung ngu yin/ /phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /dgag bya bcad pa'i med dgag tsam/ /de la ltos na med ces pa'i/ /khas len kyang ni yod pa yin/ /rgyu'am lam gyi dbu ma des/ /bden gnyis ji ltar khas blangs pa/ /gnyis ka rang gi lugs yin gyi/ /don dam rang lugs byas nas su/ /kun rdzob gzhan ngor skyel ba min/ /yin na rang lugs don dam pa/ /49

rkyang rkyang po ru gyur nas kyang / /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i snang ba kun/ /'khrul ba spang bya kho na zhes/ /skur pa 'debs shing mthar phyin tshe/ /sgrib bral dbyings stong 'ba' zhig tsam/ /lhag mar lus nas mkhyen gnyis sogs/ /med 'dod nyan rang rang lam gyi/ /lhag med myang 'das 'dod ji bzhin/ /'dir yang mar me rgyun chad dang / /don khyad med phyir zung 'jug dbyings/ /med par skur 'debs nam mkha' dang / /'dra ba'i yid can shākya yi/ /bstan pa'i rkun po dam pa'i chos/ /'jigs pa'i skyes bur rgyal bas gsungs/ /rigs pas kyang ni de 'dra'i lugs/ /yod la med par skur pa'i tshul/ /yin par nges shes rdo rje'i mes/ /lta ngan ri bo brlags par nus/ /des na dbu ma'i gzhung kun tu/ /shes rab rgyu yi dbu ma nyid/ /rigs pas dpyad cing ma grub par/ /'bras bu zung 'jug mi grub phyir / /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul du ni/ /rigs pas gtan la phab na yang / /'bras bu bden pa dbyer med du/ /grub pa rgyu 'bras theg pa'i bcud/ /de phyir ye shes de dag ni/ /res 'jog tshul gyis mtha' gnyis la/ /mi gnas blo las 'das pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma yin la chen po'ang yin/ /ji srid res 'jog tshul gyis ni/ /ye shes de la ma reg par/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthil/ /mthar thug 50

dbu ma chen po min/ /gtsub shing gtsubs pa'i me bzhin du/ /bden gnyis shes rab dri med kyis/ /drangs pa zung 'jug ye shes che/ /yod med yin min la sogs pa/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros kun nyer zhi ba'i / /'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes nyid/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu'i dbu mar bzhag /bden gnyis phyogs su ma lhung ba/ /de la rjes thob shes rab kyis/ /snang stong zung du 'jug pa zhes/ /brda tsam sgo nas bzhag mod kyi/ /mnyam bzhag ye shes chen po'i ngor/ /snang dang stong dang zung 'jug gi /ngo bor dmigs su yod ma yin/ /snang ba tha snyad tshad ma'i yul/ /stong pa don dam dpyod pa'i yul/ /zung 'jug de gnyis 'dres pa'i cha/ /de rnams sgra rtog yul yin phyir / /de las 'das pa'i mnyam bzhag ni/ /so so rang gi ye shes tsam / /snang bcas snang med la sogs kyang / /de bzhin rig pas mi 'grub bo/ /des na ji srid res 'jog gi /bden gnyis bsgom pa shes rab ste/ /nam zhig res 'jog med par yang / /zung 'jug ye shes thob pa'i tshe/ /phung po dgag bya rnam dpyad kyis/ /bcad pa'i med dgag stong rkyang las/ /'das te 'gog dang dgag bya yi/ /tshul du so sor mi snang ba/ /snang cha thabs kyi rnam pa dang / /ldan pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ /stong nyid spros bral chen po dang / /lhan 51

skyes phyag rgya chen po sogs/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang mnga' ba/ /sems 'das ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /rtog pa gzhan gyis bsam mi khyab / /de ni sgra rtog yul min phyir/ /med dgag ma yin dgag sogs dang / /tha dad dang ni snang stong sogs/ /ris su chad pa med pa ste/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral bas na/ /khas len yod med las 'das kyang / /e waṃ zung du zhugs pa yi/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /de ltar khas len las 'das pa'i/ /sgro skur dang bral dam pa'i don/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul/ /'di zhes mtshon brjod med par 'dod/ /'on kyang bsam min byed po ltar / /su yis rtogs med ma yin te/ /dri med rigs pas dpyad pa yis / /rab drangs so so rang rig pa'i/ /rjes las thob pa'i ye shes kyi / /nges shes chos kyi mar me ni/ /the tshom smag dang bral ba dag /mngon sum snang ba yod phyir ro/ /mdo lam thabs dang shes rab gnyis / /gcig la gcig gis rtsis zin par/ /byed kyi 'dir ni thabs shes nyid/ /'du 'bral med par rtogs goms nyid/ /spros bral dbu ma chen po dang / /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po gnyis/ /don gcig ming gi rnam grangs te/ /de las lhag pa'i lta ba med/ /gang phyir snang stong res 'jog tu/ /'dzin med mtha' bzhi'i spros pa 52

dang / /bral phyir de las gzhan gyur na/ /spros dang bcas pa nyid phyir ro/ /'on kyang mdo las zung 'jug don/ /dpyad pas gtan la phab pa nyid/ /sngags su rang gi rig dbyings su/ /thad kur myong bas grub pa yin/ /de phyir dbu ma zhes pa yang / /bden gnyis so sor dpyod pa yi/ /shes rab lam gyi dbu ma dang / /des drangs bden gnyis ro gcig pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu'i dbu ma gnyis/ /rgyu 'bras mdo sngags lta ba ste/ /snga ma shes rab cha yin la/ /phyi ma ye shes kho na yin/ /de phyir phyi ma 'di la ni/ /chen po'i sgra yis khyad du bsngags/ /gnas lugs la yang de bzhin du/ /dngos po stong pa'i gnas lugs dang / /bden gnyis dbyer med gnas lugs gnyis / /ming gcig na yang don la ni/ /khyad par gnam sa bzhin du mchis/ /de bzhin chos nyid chos dbyings dang / /stong nyid spros bral 'gog pa'i mtha'/ /don dam la sogs sgra mtshungs kyang / /mthar thug dang ni nyi tshe ba'i/ /khyad par che phyir skabs so sor/ /phye nas ma nor bshad bya ste/ /sen+ta pa yi sgra bzhin no/ /de ltar zab mo'i dri ba bdun/ /zab rgyas don can tshig rnams kyis/ /bkrol tshe dri ba po de yang / /gus bcas ngag gis 'di skad du/ /kye ma khron pa'i chu la rus sbal bzhin/ /gzhan gzhung chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i 53

'jings / /ma mthong rang bzhed khron pas dregs pa'i ro/ /myong ldan bdag cag khengs pa gtam 'dis bsnyil/ /rong klong zhes grags 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i gar/ /'phags mchog thugs kyi rgya mtsho chen po na/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i chos mdzod mang mnga' ba/ /de spangs gzhan lugs mching bur re rnams 'khrul/ /chos bzang rig pas rnam dpyad bsam pa can/ /rtag tu bdud kyi bar chad byed pa med / /de phyir rigs lam seng ge'i sgra bo che/ /bsgrags pas mtsho skyes bstan pa'i rang lugs kyi/ /khyad par mchog la yid ches rnyed gyur cing / /phyogs res dregs pa'i gzhan phyogs sun 'byin pa/ /mi 'phrog shes rab ral gri'i yu ba la/ /brten pa'i go skabs gzhan la sbyin par mdzod/ /chos tshul thos pa bdud rtsi'i mtsho 'dra la/ /zab mo'i don gang de yi nor bu bzhin/ /de dag gang na gnas kyang blang bya ste/ /ltar snang gang zag rjes su 'brang mi bya/ /mang thos mang du smra bas kyang min la/ /skyes sbyangs zab zab ltar snang dpyad pas kyang / /mi phigs zab don sa 'og gter 'dra ba/ /gang gis 'di 'dzin blo ldan nyid du shes/ /blo gter 'bum phrag nor bu'i snod nyid du / /bdag blo zab yangs rgya mtsho cher bsgrubs pa'i/ /gdams pa'i legs byas slong ba'i dus rig nas/ /klu dbang dpal gyi rgya mtshor 54

dga' bzhin 'thungs/ /gang las babs pa'i legs bshad chu klung gis / /rnam dpyod blo yi rgya mtsho khyon yangs par/ /nges rtogs de yi 'byung gnas klu dbang ni/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal lung nyid du rtogs / /mkha' mtha' hub kyis 'dren cing zos pa'i bcud/ /snying la kun phan bdud rtsi'i dpyid nyid du/ /len pa'i mthu chen blo la thob mdzad pa'i/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi mar me gsal bar mdzod/ /de skad zer zhing gus btud tshe/ /drang srong de yis de la yang / /zab min zab rgyas su bsgrubs pa/ /gong gi don bsdus 'di ltar gdams//chos mchog seng ge'i 'o ma ni/ /blo gros snod bzang kho nas 'dzin/ /gzhan du 'bad kyang mi gnas ltar/ /'di shong snod ni 'di yin no/ /a ni ma skyes chos kyi sgo/ /ra ni rdul dang bral ba'i sgo/ /pa ni don dam snang ba'i sgo/ /tsa ni 'chi 'pho skye ba med/ /na ni ming dang bral ba nyid/ /dhīḥ ni blo gros zab mo'i sgo/ /sgo drug de dag re re yang / /bden gnyis tshul gyis dmigs nas su/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin bsgrubs byas na/ /mtha' med rgya mtsho chen po'i chu/ /hub kyis lto ba 'dren nus pa'i/ /snying ga'i nor bu dri med la/ /gzungs spobs blo yi dpal du 'bar/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa khegs pa'i nges shes kyi/ /lam nas yin lugs gshis su son pa yi/ /blo las 'das pa 'od gsal 55

gnyug ma'i dbyings/ /'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du zhog /mtha' bral lta ba'i rgyal po yangs pa'i klong / /mnyam par bzhag pa'i bden don mthong ba las/ /mtha' bzhi'i blo ngan mun pa'i snang ba kun / /ngang gis 'gags pa'i 'od gsal nyi ma 'char/ /gzur gnas dpyod pa drang srong ste/ /thol byung rtog pa ldom bu ba/ /de des dris lan tshul gyis ni/ /dka' gnad rgyal srid grangs ldan bshad / /blo chung rtog ge bdag 'dra yis/ /shin tu zab cing brling pa'i don/ /blo chen 'phags pa'i thugs nas kyang / /blangs pa bzhin du 'di na bkod/ /de skad smras pa'i legs bshad chos kyi char / /rgyal sras bye bas bgrod cing dga' bzhin gyis/ /mnyan pas don chen thob par sems pa yis/ /dris la yi rangs bdud rtsi'i go skabs dbye/ /da phyir de bas de ltar yang dang yang / /zab rgyas don sems du ma'i don du yang / /yid kyi me long ngos la ji shar bzhin / /rtsed 'jo'i rol pas dhīḥming can gyis spel/ /bde gshegs chos tshul zab mo nam mkha'i mtha'/ /rnam pa kun tu brjod par mi nus kyang / /nges shes rin po che yi sgron me 'dir/ /brten na theg mchog lam bzang rnyed par nus/ /maṅgal/ /56
spro/ /nges shes rin po che'i sgron me'i tshig gi don gsal ba'i 'grel chung blo gros snang ba'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /kun bzang dpal ldan gyis mdzad/

mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄7/ /na mo gu ru mañju shrī ye/ /skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i tog /rgyal sras brgyad dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i lo paṇa sogs/ /'phags bod dam pa'i tshogs rnams dad brgyas bsnyen/ /sde gsum klong dgu'i shing rta klong chen pa/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med gling / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi dbang / /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa rgyal gyur cig /rgyal ba'i ye shes mtshan dper shar ba'i lha/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje ngur smrig gar gyi rol/ /chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen mi pham pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma snying gi pad+mar rol/ /yun ring sbyang ba'i dka' ba khur bzod pa'i/ /lnga rigs smra ba'i mkhas par cher grags kyang / /zab mo'i gnas 'di rtogs dkar rab gzigs nas/ /ji bzhin smra ba'i spobs pa bskyungs grags na/ /sgra tshad snyan ngag sdeb sbyor ma byang zhing / /skyes sbyangs blo gros dman pa bdag 'dra yis/ /zab don smra ba'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang / /de lta na yang rnga dang dbyug gu bzhin/ /blo gros dman par gyur kyang 59

rtogs dka'i gnas/ /gzhung 'dir bsten na yang dag mthong ba'i mig /dri med bde blag nyid du 'byed pa'i phyir/ /phan pa'i sems kyis tshig don gsal bar bya/ /rgyal ba mchog dang rgyal sras mchog rnams dang / /ma hā gu ru blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i bden mthu yis/ /'di yis bstan 'gror sman par byin gyis rlobs/ /de la 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku nyid mtshan dpe'i gzugs skur shar ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje rje btsun ma hā gu ru blo ldan mchog sred rtsal dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i khyab bdag rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma nyid sku na shin tu gzhon pa'i dus su zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don zab cing shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung bzang sdeb sbyor gyi spros pa spang ba gang shar lhug par stan gcig tu brtsam par mdzad pa'i legs bshad 'di bshad pa la gsum/ thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ tha mar dge ba mjug gi don no/ /60

thog mar dge ba klad kyi don/dang po la gnyis/ mtshan bstan pa dang / mchod par brjod pa'o / /mtshan bstan pa/dang po/ nges shes rin po che'i sgron me bzhugs so zhes pas bstan te/ gzhung bzang 'di la legs par brten na zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas zab mo'i de kho na nyid la sgro bskur kun dang bral ba'i nges pa'i shes pa the tshom gyi smag thams cad dang bral ba'i yid ches phyir mi ldog pa'i blo mig yang dag pa rang rgyud la bde blag tu bskyed pa'i phyir dper na mun pa sel zhing mthong ba'i snang ba sbyin pa'i/ rin po che'i sgron me rin thang dang bral ba lta bu 'di na bzhugs so zhes dpe don zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas mtshan du btags pa'o/ /61

mchod par brjod pa/gnyis pa/ gang yid the tshom sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstan te/ lung rigs zab mo'i de nyid don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gang gi yid zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don zab mo rtogs par dka' ba'i da gnas/ yin nam ma yin snyam pa'i the tshom gyi dra ba'i sbubs su 'thums nas lung rigs dang mi 'gal ba'i don 'di yin no zhes gcig tu thag chod med par khas len ci bya gtol med du 'phyan pa las zab rgyas kyi de nyid so sor 'byed cing rtogs par byed pa'i bden gnyis dpyod pa'i tshad ma dri ma ched pa'i mkhyen rab 9 ( jam dpal rdo rje'i mar me mchog tu 'bar bar gyur pa 'di ni zab rgyas kyi de nyid zab mo gsal bar byed pa dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi snying la zab rgyas kyi don la sgro bskur dang yid gnyis kun dang bral ba'i nges pa'i shes pa zab mo'i tshul sus kyang mi 'phrog pa rnam par dag pa bde blag tu 'dren cing 'jug par byed pa yang dag pa'i tshad ma gnyis nas lam bzang po bden pa gnyis kyi gshes lugs yang dag par mthong ba'i mig tu gyur pa der bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bdag nyid kyang rab dad do — — — — —

zhes mchod par brjod pa'o/ /kyang sgras zab rgyas kyi de nyid zab mo mthong bar 'dod pas tshad ma'i mig bzang dad pas bskyed dgos par bstan to/ /bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/gnyis pa/ bar du dge ba gzhung don la bzhi/ gleng gzhi'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa/ yi rangs kyis bsngags pa brjod cing don bsdus te gdams pa/ ji ltar bstan pa'i don bsdu ba'o/ /sa bcad dang po/ gleng gzhi'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/dang po la bzhi/ tshad ma gnyis dang bral ba'i skyon/ lam yang dag dang de'i gzugs brnyan gyi khyad par/ lam yang dag dang der zhugs pa la bsngags pa/ dri lan tshul gyis ji ltar bstan tshul bshad pa'o/ /63

gcig tshad ma gnyis dang bral ba'i skyon/dang po/ kye ma zab mo'i sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstan te/kye ma'o tha snyad dang don dam pa'i zab mo'i gnas lugs ma nor bar rtogs pa la yang dag par sbyor bar byed pa'i bden gnyis dpyod pa'i tshad ma gnyes kyis drang pa'i nges shes rin po che yi sgron me lta bur gyur pa khyod nyid rang rgyud la ma bskyed cing med pas na srid pa 'di na thos bsam sgom pa phal cher gnas lugs zab mo'i don la the tshom gyi sgyu ma'i rgyar ni 'thums shing blang dor khas len la rmongs par gyur pa'i skyon 'di byung ba'o// da waganyis/ lam yang dag dang de'i gzugs brnyan gyi khyad par/gnyis pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan te/ rgyu 'bras sam mdo sngags kyi theg pa gang la zhugs kyang /gzhi snang stong ngam stong dang rten 'byung / lam thabs shes sam chogs gnyis/ 'bras bu'i chos ni sku gnyis la srogs pa yi bsdus 64

pa'i chos rnams la rang gis lung rigs tshad ma'i lam nas drangs pa'i nges pas yid ches sus kyang mi 'phrog pa rang rgyud la 'drong ba dang gzhan las thos pas dad par byed pa tsam las nges pas yid ches rang rgyud la ma 'drong ba gnyis ni lam dngos dang de yi gzugs brnyan bzhin te lam yang ga dang gtso nga ba'o/ /gsum / lam yang dag dang der zhugs pa la bsngags pa/gsum pa/ rmad byung chos kyi sogs tshigs bcad bzhis bstan te / rgyan 'grel du/ don dam mkha' ltar zhi ba'i thugs brnyes pas//dpal ldan zla ba 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /tha snyad 'ja' ltar ma 'dres gsal gzigs pas/ /chos kyi grags pas sa chen 'dir khyab kyang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don bzhin/ /yon tan rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon dpal chos kyi grags pa dang de kho na nyid gsal bar mdzad pa dpal ldan zla ba'i grags pa ni tshad ma dang dbu ma'i legs par bshad pa'i gsungs gi 'od zer dang chabs cig par ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa'i lha lam ste nam mkha' yangs por shar nga ste da wa 6
