gis 'tshal/ /de lta na yang 'khor lo'i mgon po yi/ /bka' yis gnang bskul don ldan mthong phyir dang / 7 /bdag yid goms phyir gzhan dag bskul phyir dang / /phan pa'i sems phyir tshig gsal 'di byas so/ /zab phyir dngos bstan tsam yang rtogs min na/ /tshig nus dang ni shugs bstan lta yang ci/ 8 /de phyir rang mthong byis pas ma rtogs pas/ /ma tshang ma 'brel mi dgos la sogs pa'i/ /nyes pa gang mchis rtsa gsum srung ma dang / /chos spyan ldan la 'chags kyi dag tshangs stsol/ 9 /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing / /bshad sgrub bstan pa rtag tu dar rgyas te/ /snod bcud rdzogs ldan 'byor ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ 10 /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub mchog gi bar/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum rjes bzung nas / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rtag tu rnam rgyal te/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos 'dzin gyur cig 11 /'di dang gang 'brel 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis/ /byin rlabs rjes bzung tshe ring nad med cing / /nges don snying po'i lam bzang mthong gyur te/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'dzin skyong spel gyur cig 12 /mkha' khyab zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bden mthu yis/ /283

ji ltar smon pa 'grub pa'i mthun gyur dang / /phyogs dus kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis stsol/ 13 /de ltar mdo rgyud grub mtha'i zab khyad/nyams len bsgom pa'i gnad gsang / khas len nyan 'byed kyi gsang lam nges shes rin po che'i sgron me 'di rang chung nas mjal zhing mos pas zhugs kyang nges pa'i don gyis dbul na yang / gangs can mngon par mtho ba'i ma gha dha gnyis par grags pa'i shar rgyal ba'i kuḥthog rdo rje'i gdan gyi zi la'i bstan pa bshad sgrub las gsum gyis gzhir bzhes su mdzad pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen po si tu rin po ches gsar du bskrun pa'i rgyud sde lha khang thub bstan bshad sgrub nor bu'i lhun por rje nyid kyi bdag rkyen las gzhung mang rab kyi bshad pa bgyid tshe gzhung 'di 'chad skabs/ bka' drin mtshungs bral bla ma rin po che thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas bshad lung legs par mnos shing bsdus don zhig kyang bka' bskul gnang /khyad par phyis su yang gdan sa rin po che der kun mkhyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bka' yi bsdu ba'i thugs stsol gnang ba'i bdag rkyen mchog gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang /'di ka sogs kyi bshad lung phul skabs/ bdag cag gi bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po mdo sngags bstan pa yongs kyi rgyal 284

mtshan snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/7'jam mgon si tu rin po che kun gzigs chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid na mngon par mtho ba gang gis bkra shis pa'i lha regagasang sngags kyi nang gi dam tshig gi rten mchog dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rdo rje dang dril bu/ rdo rje'i yang tsho bsgrub pa'i rin po che'i ril bu dang bri gzhi'i shog bu bcas bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor yang yang stsal gnang nyid/ rten 'brel gyi dgongs gnad che bar mos shing rang yang mchog gi bstan bcos kyis bstan rgyun srid mthar spel ba'i sa bon bzang po rtsom pa'i skal bzang du bgyid pa'i dad mos legs mthong dang / gzhan yang lung rigs smra ba'i chos kyi spyan ldan du mas bka' yi bskul ngor chud gsan ma phod par skyes sbyangs blo gros ldan la 'di 'dras ci yang mi mkho bas na rje kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i legs bshad sogs mkhas pa'i rigs lam zab mo rnams bsdu zhing mdo rgyud zab mo'i lung sbyar mang du 'bri bar byas na / yi ge mang du dogs nas rgyas spros dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor bskyungs nas rang 'dra'i skal mnyam las dang po ba shes brtson zhan pa'i rigs rnams la tshig don gsal ba'i 'bru 'grel go ci bde gtso bor byas na 285

blo gros snang ba'i sgo 'byed du cung zad phan du re ba'i sems kyis o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul rin po che/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mang po'i zhabs rdul reg pa'i slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal shākya'i btsun gzugs rmongs rtul gyi na ba tshe rabs kun tu o rgyan pad+ma'i bran du smon pa'i yid can kun bzang dpal ldan nam thub bstan kun bzang chos grags su 'bod pas/ dpal sprul rin po che'i gdan sa'i mthil dkar chung ri khrod dben gnas dam pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par rig 'dzin 'chi med grub pa'i chos sgar thub bstan bshad sgrub gling du o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa gangs ljongs bod yul dbus su byon te mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshes bcu'i dus mchod dang bcas par rdzogs par bgyis pa 'dis kyang phyogs dus kun tu ris med pa'i bstan 'gro la sman par bslu ba med pa'i bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam bden pa chen po'i mthus byin gyis brlabs par mdzad de dar zhing rgyas la dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /shu lha/ sarba maṅgal/ /286

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ pad+ma tshul khrims/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ bkra shis/ pad+ma tshul khrims/nges shes sgron me rtsa 'grel bzhugs/'ju mi pham gyis rtsa ba dang kun bzang dpal ldan gyis 'grel ba mdzad/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/khreng tu'u hru'u thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshod yod kung sis dpar/dpe rtags/ 152ga978—7—5409—3344—972 100dpe rin sgor/ 18 00
